dossier.claim: Several passages change the grounds on which Rin acts, speaks, or is understood: efficient arrangements become kindness, contempt for a vile intrusion becomes criticism of workmanship, and a teasing appeal to Shirou’s stated position becomes dismissal of his objection. Her initiative often survives while its physical expression or stated premise changes.
dossier.sourcePattern: The Japanese repeatedly specifies distinctions that shape the interaction: Rin answers her father's gravity with decorum; her present harsh manner contrasts with her school behavior; enthusiasm for teaching is separated from aptitude; and her medical teasing recalls what Shirou has just said. Physical and practical details likewise matter: she drops her stance first, leads a follower around town, and fights while understanding her disadvantage.
dossier.englishEffect: The selected English passages sometimes replace those distinctions with different evaluations or broader descriptions. Rin becomes somber instead of decorous, harsh at school instead of in the present encounter, kind instead of efficient, and childishness becomes the target of her taunt. “Break the ice” preserves her initiative but loses its physical expression; sightseeing replaces handling a follower; “advantage” reverses her combat position. The missing teaching caveat and reversed treatment premise alter how her confidence and pressure on Shirou are framed.
dossier.limits: These examples do not establish a uniform softening, hardening, or loss of concern. The counterexamples preserve Rin’s willingness to stop treatment, her severe doctrine about enemy Masters, her reluctance to eliminate witnesses, and her initiative toward Sakura followed by a guarded explanation. No hidden motive or enduring personality change follows from these local differences.
dossier.diagnostic: 615 findings in this category; 10 cited passages.

contexts.english: Tohsaka didn't realize I dozed off for a bit

findings.description: Rin's forceful stride again becomes slow movement.
findings.sourceReading: ずかずか marks her bold or stomping return after locking the door.
findings.explanation: Rin's forceful stride again becomes slow movement.

contexts.japanese: ずかずかと奥に戻る
contexts.english: Then she slowly moves back into the room.

findings.description: Rin's pointed Emiya-kun address is again omitted.
findings.sourceReading: Her barbed line explicitly shifts to 衛宮くん.
findings.explanation: Rin's pointed Emiya-kun address is again omitted.

contexts.japanese: セイバーには優しいのよね、衛宮くんは
contexts.english: You're really considerate of her.

findings.description: Rin's tendency to fail at decisive moments becomes her biggest past failure.
findings.sourceReading: ここ一番の失敗 is failure when it matters most, which she will suppress this time.
findings.explanation: Rin's tendency to fail at decisive moments becomes her biggest past failure.

contexts.japanese: ここ一番の失敗も、今回ばかりはねじ伏せてやるわ
contexts.english: I will overcome my biggest failure with everything I've got.

findings.description: Rin's hard-to-see virtues become difficulty knowing what there is to like.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says her good qualities are hard to recognize because she hides them.
findings.explanation: Rin's hard-to-see virtues become difficulty knowing what there is to like.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂のいいところって、分かりづらいよな
contexts.english: it's hard to know what to like about you.

findings.description: Model student becomes the pejorative goodie two-shoes.
findings.sourceReading: 優等生 names Rin's polished honor-student persona.
findings.explanation: Model student becomes the pejorative goodie two-shoes.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の事を優等生だって思ってたし
contexts.english: I only thought of you as a goodie two-shoes at school

findings.description: Rin's self-accusation of wearing a false persona disappears.
findings.sourceReading: 猫かぶり calls her school persona an act before she calls herself cold.
findings.explanation: Rin's self-accusation of wearing a false persona disappears.

contexts.japanese: どうせ猫かぶりで冷酷な女ですよ
contexts.english: I'm just a woman who's cold as the iceberg.

findings.description: Rin's strong heart becomes a heart of steel 'who' acts at a moment's notice.
findings.sourceReading: She has a strong heart that decisively cuts away her own weakness.
findings.explanation: Rin's strong heart becomes a heart of steel 'who' acts at a moment's notice.

contexts.japanese: 自分の弱さをきっぱりと切り捨てる強い心
contexts.english: has the heart of steel who's willing to discard her weakness at a moment's notice.

findings.description: Rin's glowing crest-bearing arm becomes Shirou's arm already receiving mana.
findings.sourceReading: Rin extends her bare left arm; its upper-arm pattern appears as it gains energy.
findings.explanation: Rin's glowing crest-bearing arm becomes Shirou's arm already receiving mana.

contexts.japanese: 腕は剥き出しで、二の腕の模様が魔力を得てうっすらと浮かび上がっていた
contexts.english: As I began receiving magical energy, the pattern on the upper area of my exposed arm faintly started to shine.

findings.description: An unspecified farewell acquires romance and fixed genders.
findings.sourceReading: Someone remembers seeing another person off knowing they will never hold hands again.
findings.explanation: An unspecified farewell acquires romance and fixed genders.

contexts.japanese: もう手を繋ぐ事はないと見送った余人の記憶
contexts.english: The memory of a person who watched their loved one leave knowing she would never hold his hands again.

findings.description: Shirou overcoming disgust becomes Rin not feeling disgust.
findings.sourceReading: After recognizing Rin's pain and admiring her, Shirou says his own experience is no longer disgusting.
findings.explanation: Shirou overcoming disgust becomes Rin not feeling disgust.

contexts.japanese: 気持ちの悪さなどない
contexts.english: She doesn't feel any disgust.

findings.description: Rin watching until sunset becomes the jumper trying until sunset.
findings.sourceReading: 意味もなく modifies her sustained watching; his repeated runs were already stated.
findings.explanation: Rin watching until sunset becomes the jumper trying until sunset.

contexts.japanese: 意味もなく、日が沈むまで
contexts.english: It was meaningless, yet he kept trying until sunset.

findings.description: Rin looking ready to explode becomes general tension between them.
findings.sourceReading: She is so sulky she appears on the verge of a tantrum.
findings.explanation: Rin looking ready to explode becomes general tension between them.

contexts.japanese: 今にもカンシャクを起こしそうなぐらい、拗ねている
contexts.english: I can sense the tension between us... She's clearly sulking about something.

findings.description: Rin refusing to let Shirou apologize becomes refusing to apologize herself.
findings.sourceReading: ごめん、なんて言わせない makes Shirou the prospective apologizer.
findings.explanation: Rin refusing to let Shirou apologize becomes refusing to apologize herself.

contexts.japanese: ごめん、なんて言わせないわ
contexts.english: don't expect me to apologize.

findings.description: A trillion-class comparison becomes a literal trillion debt.
findings.sourceReading: If converted to money, the favor would be trillion-class; it is lifelong.
findings.explanation: A trillion-class comparison becomes a literal trillion debt.

contexts.japanese: お金にしたらもう兆クラス
contexts.english: you owe me a trillion

findings.description: Pole vault is silently normalized to high jump.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says 棒高跳び here, despite the earlier memory saying 走り高跳び.
findings.explanation: Pole vault is silently normalized to high jump.

contexts.japanese: バカみたいに棒高跳びしてるヤツ
contexts.english: an idiot who wouldn't give up on high jumping

findings.description: Shirou being unable to finish becomes Rin refusing to hear him out.
findings.sourceReading: He does not get to hear or ask through to the end before ejection.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unable to finish becomes Rin refusing to hear him out.

contexts.japanese: 最後まで聞けなかった
contexts.english: She won't hear me out at all.

findings.description: Rin's uncompromising softness becomes indulgence.
findings.sourceReading: 甘くなくては張り合いがない says her realism must coexist with thorough softheartedness/sweetness for her to be herself to Archer.
findings.explanation: Rin's uncompromising softness becomes indulgence.

contexts.japanese: とことん甘くなくては張り合いがない
contexts.english: and indulgent.

findings.description: Archer entrusting his other self to Rin becomes asking care for the present Archer.
findings.sourceReading: 私を頼む deliberately overlaps Archer with the distant boy, then immediately identifies that unreliable guy as the one Rin must support.
findings.explanation: Archer entrusting his other self to Rin becomes asking care for the present Archer.

contexts.japanese: 私を頼む。知っての通り頼りないヤツだからな
contexts.english: Please take care of me. I am an unreliable guy, as you know.

contexts.japanese: 君が、支えてやってくれ
contexts.english: Please support me.

findings.description: An actual failed inquiry and Lancer's teasing become a hypothetical question.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou did ask and Lancer did needle Rin, but she refused to explain to either.
findings.explanation: An actual failed inquiry and Lancer's teasing become a hypothetical question.

contexts.japanese: 俺が訊いてもランサーが茶化しても教えてくれなかった
contexts.english: She wouldn't tell us even if we asked

findings.description: Lancer's admission that Rin's gratitude dazzles him becomes praise of her as a Master. His loyalty constraint remains, but the personal effect of her thanks is less specific.
findings.sourceReading: Speaking as someone who cannot readily betray his own master, Lancer finds the gratitude just described a little dazzling.
findings.explanation: Lancer's admission that Rin's gratitude dazzles him becomes praise of her as a Master. His loyalty constraint remains, but the personal effect of her thanks is less specific.

contexts.japanese: おいそれと主を裏切れない身としちゃあ、少しばかり眩しいってもんだ
contexts.english: She's a great Master, but I'm not one who is able to betray my Master readily.

findings.description: Rin's pained look is specified as sorrow.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks that, for an instant, Rin seemed to bow her head painfully or in distress while running; the kind of distress is not named.
findings.explanation: Rin's pained look is specified as sorrow.

contexts.japanese: 辛そうに俯いた気がした。
contexts.english: I thought Tohsaka had hung her head in sorrow

findings.description: Rin's casual thanks just heard becomes gratitude Lancer had never heard before.
findings.sourceReading: Lancer realizes that the cause of his restraint seems to be the unremarkable thanks he heard only a short while ago.
findings.explanation: Rin's casual thanks just heard becomes gratitude Lancer had never heard before.

contexts.japanese: その原因は、つい先ほど耳にした、なんでもない礼らしい。
contexts.english: The cause seems to be the expression of gratitude that he had never heard before.

findings.description: “At an advantage” reverses Rin's position. The Japanese places her under pressure alongside Shirou, with the added burden of understanding how badly she is outmatched.
findings.sourceReading: Rin is at a disadvantage too; understanding the disparity in strength makes her burden greater than Shirou's.
findings.explanation: “At an advantage” reverses Rin's position. The Japanese places her under pressure alongside Shirou, with the added burden of understanding how badly she is outmatched.

contexts.japanese: 劣勢であるのは彼女も同じだった。
contexts.english: Tohsaka is also at an advantage.

findings.description: One treasured jewel becomes plural jewels.
findings.sourceReading: Rin cancels Aero with a single hoarded jewel, identified by its number in the incantation.
findings.explanation: One treasured jewel becomes plural jewels.

contexts.japanese: それを、彼女は秘蔵の宝石で相殺する。
contexts.english: She counters that with her treasured jewels.

findings.description: Rin's left-hand Magic Crest is omitted from the reason her abbreviated casting cannot compete.
findings.sourceReading: With no time for leisurely incantation, even the simplified casting through the Magic Crest on her left hand cannot match Caster.
findings.explanation: Rin's left-hand Magic Crest is omitted from the reason her abbreviated casting cannot compete.

contexts.japanese: 左手の魔術刻印による簡易詠唱ではキャスターの魔術に太刀打ちできない。
contexts.english: she cannot match Caster's magecraft with simple spells.

findings.description: The third-person concurrent account is assigned to Shirou with a first-person knowledge claim.
findings.sourceReading: The narration has shifted to Rin's simultaneous fight and says that the number of jewels she owns is unknown before giving Caster's rough estimate.
findings.explanation: The third-person concurrent account is assigned to Shirou with a first-person knowledge claim.

contexts.japanese: 彼女がどれほど宝石を所有しているかは知らぬが、所詮十や二十。
contexts.english: I do not know how many jewels she has, but it should be around ten or twenty.

findings.description: Rin completely blocking Caster's attacks becomes dodging them.
findings.sourceReading: Caster praises Rin for completely defending against the spells, then explains that guarding only herself would preserve the jewels.
findings.explanation: Rin completely blocking Caster's attacks becomes dodging them.

contexts.japanese: あら、綺麗に防ぎきるのね。
contexts.english: Oh, you dodge them well.

findings.description: The fourth jewel is presented as an additional consumption after three jewels.
findings.sourceReading: Rin releases three jewels—numbers five, three, and four—and uses the treasured number four within that set to layer the forbidden synergy.
findings.explanation: The fourth jewel is presented as an additional consumption after three jewels.

contexts.japanese: 加えて虎の子の四番を用いて、禁呪である相乗さえ重ねた。
contexts.english: Additionally, she uses her treasured fourth jewel to add a synergistic effect.

findings.description: A kick intended almost to break Caster's legs becomes kicking them off.
findings.sourceReading: Rin's full-body sweep explodes as if it might kick and break Caster's legs.
findings.explanation: A kick intended almost to break Caster's legs becomes kicking them off.

contexts.japanese: キャスターの足を蹴り折らんとばかりに炸裂する
contexts.english: as if trying to kick off Caster's legs.

findings.description: Rin's genuinely unfavorable magic battle becomes merely acting disadvantaged.
findings.sourceReading: Unable to beat Caster in magecraft, Rin deliberately conducts an unfavorable magic battle as preparation for a one-use physical ambush.
findings.explanation: Rin's genuinely unfavorable magic battle becomes merely acting disadvantaged.

contexts.japanese: あえて不利な魔術戦を演じたのか。
contexts.english: She acted like she was at a disadvantage

findings.description: Rin’s commitment to carry her path through becomes merely believing in it.
findings.sourceReading: For as long as she is Archer’s Master, Rin will follow through on the path she believes in, as his former self did.
findings.explanation: Rin’s commitment to carry her path through becomes merely believing in it.

contexts.japanese: 自分の信じた道を貫き通す。
contexts.english: I will believe in my path like he used to do.

findings.description: Rin swallowing the consequence and fixing Archer with a strong gaze becomes taking another breath and staring.
findings.sourceReading: After accepting in one breath that her words may end their bond, Rin fixes the shadowed man with a strong gaze.
findings.explanation: Rin swallowing the consequence and fixing Archer with a strong gaze becomes taking another breath and staring.

contexts.japanese: それを一息で呑み込んで、強く、影になった男を見据えた。
contexts.english: I take a breath and stare at the man in the shadows.

findings.description: Existential affirmation of people like Shirou becomes Rin being saved by possessing one.
findings.sourceReading: Rin is saved by the thought that Shirou must be as he is and that someone like him is allowed to exist.
findings.explanation: Existential affirmation of people like Shirou becomes Rin being saved by possessing one.

contexts.japanese: ああいうヤツがいてもいいんだって救われてる
contexts.english: I'm saved by having a guy like him.

findings.description: Rin remains Kotomine's apprentice beneath a saintly smile, but she is no longer explicitly called a sacrificial victim. The surrounding threat survives while this religious contrast is reduced.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine's saintly smile is directed at a sacrificial victim who was his apprentice for ten years.
findings.explanation: Rin remains Kotomine's apprentice beneath a saintly smile, but she is no longer explicitly called a sacrificial victim. The surrounding threat survives while this religious contrast is reduced.

contexts.japanese: 十年間、弟子だった生け贄を見下ろしている。
contexts.english: The priest looks down at his apprentice of ten years with a saintly smile.

findings.description: Rin condemning Kotomine to an unsuitable heaven becomes placing him outside heaven where he does not belong.
findings.sourceReading: After hell and purgatory reject him, Rin's punch line is that a failed corpse like him should suffer on a bed of needles in heaven precisely because heaven does not suit his nature.
findings.explanation: Rin condemning Kotomine to an unsuitable heaven becomes placing him outside heaven where he does not belong.

contexts.japanese: 性に合わない天国あたりで針の筵にくるまってろっての
contexts.english: DESERVES TO GET TURNED INTO A PINCUSHION JUST OUTSIDE OF HEAVEN, WHERE YOU DEFINITELY DON'T BELONG

findings.description: Rin's probable understanding of the Grail-vessel plan becomes certainty.
findings.sourceReading: Only Kotomine and probably Rin, the intended sacrifice, understand what he means; the narrator explicitly qualifies her comprehension.
findings.explanation: Rin's probable understanding of the Grail-vessel plan becomes certainty.

contexts.japanese: おそらく、生け贄とされる遠坂凛本人だけだろう。
contexts.english: Only the priest and the girl he intends to sacrifice do.

findings.description: Kotomine gripping Rin's chest over her heart becomes shoving his hand into her chest.
findings.sourceReading: Before the delayed piercing reveal, he rudely seizes her chest above the heart as if he could easily pull the heart out.
findings.explanation: Kotomine gripping Rin's chest over her heart becomes shoving his hand into her chest.

contexts.japanese: 神父の右手は無遠慮に少女の胸—心臓の上を鷲づかみにする。
contexts.english: The priest roughly shoves his hand into the girl's chest, over where her heart would be.

findings.description: Rin's resolute declaration becomes a scoff delivered as though to a child.
findings.sourceReading: Still bound hand and foot, Rin says it firmly and with composure.
findings.explanation: Rin's resolute declaration becomes a scoff delivered as though to a child.

contexts.japanese: 手足を縛られたまま、遠坂凛は屹然と言い放った。
contexts.english: Rin scoffs like she's talking to a child.

findings.description: Rin's startling vigor becomes being alive and well.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou is disarmed by how energetic Rin is, despite her visible injuries and recent captivity.
findings.explanation: Rin's startling vigor becomes being alive and well.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の元気っぷりには、正直毒気を抜かれた。
contexts.english: I'm honestly amazed to see Tohsaka alive and well.

findings.description: Rin firing raw stored jewel energy becomes charging the jewel with as much energy as possible.
findings.sourceReading: She simply slams out the unprocessed destructive impact of the magical energy already stored in a jewel.
findings.explanation: Rin firing raw stored jewel energy becomes charging the jewel with as much energy as possible.

contexts.japanese: 宝石に籠めた魔力を叩き込むだけ
contexts.english: Tohsaka charges a jewel with as much energy as she can

findings.description: Rin arguing that a king is meaningless without any humans becomes saying one death does not matter to a king.
findings.sourceReading: She attacks Gilgamesh's extermination plan: if not a single human remains, the very meaning of being king disappears.
findings.explanation: Rin arguing that a king is meaningless without any humans becomes saying one death does not matter to a king.

contexts.japanese: 人間が一人もいなくなったら、それこそ王様の意味なんてないじゃない！
contexts.english: It doesn't matter to a king whether one person dies or not!?

findings.description: Rin managing the two-way magical-energy allocation becomes the allocation working itself out.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says she can manage because Shirou's share is small relative to Saber's, though reckless output remains impossible.
findings.explanation: Rin managing the two-way magical-energy allocation becomes the allocation working itself out.

contexts.japanese: 士郎に分ける魔力は小さいからなんとかやっていけるわ。
contexts.english: I'm not giving you much power compared to Saber, so it'll work itself out.

findings.description: Shirou condemning himself for missing Rin's pain becomes condemning Rin as a fool.
findings.sourceReading: Realizing that Rin also does not want Saber to disappear, Shirou calls himself an idiot for failing to see her distress.
findings.explanation: Shirou condemning himself for missing Rin's pain becomes condemning Rin as a fool.

contexts.japanese: くそ、なんて馬鹿だ。
contexts.english: Damn it. What a fool she is.

findings.description: Shirou's trust that a Rin capable of declaring this can reach Shinji becomes only a possibility.
findings.sourceReading: He recognizes obvious bravado, yet concludes that precisely Rin, able to make that declaration, can make it across.
findings.explanation: Shirou's trust that a Rin capable of declaring this can reach Shinji becomes only a possibility.

contexts.japanese: そう断言できる遠坂なら辿り着ける。
contexts.english: Tohsaka might actually be able to get across if she says so.

findings.description: Rin's bug-crushing comparison uses malformed quantity English.
findings.sourceReading: Each step gives her the sensation of crushing a huge number of insects.
findings.explanation: Rin's bug-crushing comparison uses malformed quantity English.

contexts.japanese: 大量の虫を踏み潰すような悪寒
contexts.english: like she's stepping on a mass number of bugs.

findings.description: The curse becoming fatal on the first step becomes each step merely approaching fatality.
findings.sourceReading: Its nerve invasion, strength theft, and brain-boiling effect is already lethal once a person takes one step; an ordinary person stops after two.
findings.explanation: The curse becoming fatal on the first step becomes each step merely approaching fatality.

contexts.japanese: 一歩歩いた時点で致命的となる。
contexts.english: every step taken is a step closer to fatality.

findings.description: The Tohsaka Imperial Army becomes the generic Tohsaka army.
findings.sourceReading: The narration jokingly casts Rin as an imperial army calmly counterattacking Taiga’s advance.
findings.explanation: The Tohsaka Imperial Army becomes the generic Tohsaka army.

contexts.japanese: 帝国軍。
contexts.english: the Tohsaka army

findings.description: Rin’s formal needling contains the malformed phrase “whether how you call.”
findings.sourceReading: She says it is no concern of hers how the teacher addresses Emiya.
findings.explanation: Rin’s formal needling contains the malformed phrase “whether how you call.”

contexts.japanese: 先生が衛宮くんをどう呼ぼうとわたしには関係ありません
contexts.english: It does not concern me whether how you call Emiya.

findings.description: What Sakura may have told Rin becomes something Rin and Sakura discussed.
findings.sourceReading: Rin refuses to say what Matou was talking about, using privacy to avoid confirming whether Sakura supplied the suspected information.
findings.explanation: What Sakura may have told Rin becomes something Rin and Sakura discussed.

contexts.japanese: 間桐さんが何を話していたのかも個人のプライバシーですから
contexts.english: it would be improper to say what I've discussed with Miss Matou

findings.description: Shirou being captivated by Rin washing dishes becomes the scene merely being strangely picturesque and mundane.
findings.sourceReading: Despite his frustration, Rin at the sink makes such a complete picture that he cannot help gazing at her in admiration.
findings.explanation: Shirou being captivated by Rin washing dishes becomes the scene merely being strangely picturesque and mundane.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂は見惚れるぐらい絵になっていたのだ。
contexts.english: there's something strangely picturesque about Tohsaka standing there doing something so mundane.

findings.description: Rin’s challenging glare becomes treating Shirou as a challenge she must surmount.
findings.sourceReading: She glares with a confrontational, challenging attitude after realizing he lacks awareness.
findings.explanation: Rin’s challenging glare becomes treating Shirou as a challenge she must surmount.

contexts.japanese: 挑むような態度で、遠坂は睨んできた。
contexts.english: Tohsaka glares at me as if I'm a challenge to surmount.

findings.description: Rin offering to alter Shirou’s procedure for him becomes Shirou changing it himself.
findings.sourceReading: Rin considers that she may be able to make him immediately useful by changing the Projection procedure for him a little.
findings.explanation: Rin offering to alter Shirou’s procedure for him becomes Shirou changing it himself.

contexts.japanese: 少し手順を変えてあげるだけで
contexts.english: if you change your process a bit.

findings.description: Shirou’s plan to send Rin home before she does anything extra loses its preventive condition.
findings.sourceReading: Once she returns, he will finish their business and drive her home before she can do anything unnecessary.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s plan to send Rin home before she does anything extra loses its preventive condition.

contexts.japanese: 余計なコトする前に家にたたき帰す
contexts.english: I'm going to send her home right away!

findings.description: Shirou’s calm beside Rin becomes calm despite being beside “the girl I admire so much.”
findings.sourceReading: He simply observes that Rin is this close yet he is strangely calm; the passage does not label his feeling as admiration.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s calm beside Rin becomes calm despite being beside “the girl I admire so much.”

contexts.japanese: こんなに近くに遠坂がいるのに、不思議と気持ちは落ち着いている。
contexts.english: The girl I admire so much is so close, yet I'm strangely calm.

findings.description: Rin seeming to want Shirou to ask becomes seeming to want to ask him something.
findings.sourceReading: Sensing that she wants the opening, Shirou prompts her to say what the conversation is about.
findings.explanation: Rin seeming to want Shirou to ask becomes seeming to want to ask him something.

contexts.japanese: なんとなく聞かれたがってるな
contexts.english: I felt like she wanted to ask me something

findings.description: Rin wondering whether Shirou is all right as he is becomes reassuring him that he need not learn differently and is fine as he is.
findings.sourceReading: The unusual house makes her reflect on others and question whether Shirou can safely remain in his present condition.
findings.explanation: Rin wondering whether Shirou is all right as he is becomes reassuring him that he need not learn differently and is fine as he is.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮くんはそのままでもいいのかなって、ふと思った
contexts.english: maybe you don't have to learn like that. I suppose, well, it might be you're just fine the way you are.

findings.description: Rin originally points out that Shirou's defense itself proves how blunt he is. English makes her say the remark was predictable, changing the punchline.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou's claim that he copied Rin's indirectness itself bluntly criticizes her. Rin points to that very response as evidence of his directness.
findings.explanation: Rin originally points out that Shirou's defense itself proves how blunt he is. English makes her say the remark was predictable, changing the punchline.

contexts.japanese: そういうところが直球だって言ってるの
contexts.english: I saw it coming a mile away.

findings.description: Narration’s certainty that Rin’s smile contains no bluff or falsehood becomes only what Shirou can discern.
findings.sourceReading: The narration affirms without qualification that she is neither putting on a brave face nor lying and is genuinely smiling with pleasure.
findings.explanation: Narration’s certainty that Rin’s smile contains no bluff or falsehood becomes only what Shirou can discern.

contexts.japanese: そこには強がりも偽りもなく
contexts.english: There is no bluster or lies that I can make out.

findings.description: Rin cooperating because Shirou is interesting becomes cooperating because he is funny.
findings.sourceReading: She finds him an interesting person or case, consistent with curiosity and engagement rather than saying he makes her laugh.
findings.explanation: Rin cooperating because Shirou is interesting becomes cooperating because he is funny.

contexts.japanese: 貴方が面白いからだし
contexts.english: I'm working with you because you're funny.

findings.description: Shirou recognizing his burden narrative as his own assumption becomes claiming general ignorance about such matters.
findings.sourceReading: After Rin explains her chosen path, he explicitly retracts his projection that the Tohsaka lineage must weigh on her as a dark shadow.
findings.explanation: Shirou recognizing his burden narrative as his own assumption becomes claiming general ignorance about such matters.

contexts.japanese: けれどそんなのはこっちの思いこみだ。
contexts.english: But I guess I don't really have a clue about that sort of thing.

findings.description: Rin presenting her inference as obvious becomes Shirou endorsing it as the natural conclusion.

contexts.japanese: わたし以外の誰かが、衛宮くんを誘き出したのかと思った
contexts.english: Who else besides me would invite you out here?

findings.description: Not being close enough for a proper personal letter becomes not writing something formal.
findings.sourceReading: 親しくなってない supplies relationship distance as the reason she wrote only business.
findings.explanation: Not being close enough for a proper personal letter becomes not writing something formal.

contexts.japanese: ちゃんとした手紙を送れるほど親しくなってない
contexts.english: it's not like I'd write something formal to you

findings.description: Being genuinely ready to attack then becomes now wishing she had attacked.
findings.sourceReading: 見た時は本気でその気になった locates the resolve at seeing him casually walk that morning.
findings.explanation: Being genuinely ready to attack then becomes now wishing she had attacked.

contexts.japanese: 見た時は本気でその気になった
contexts.english: makes me wish I'd gone for it.

findings.description: Anger fading on seeing his face becomes merely no longer being angry.
findings.sourceReading: 貴方の顔見たら identifies the personal trigger of the unexpectedly conciliatory shift.
findings.explanation: Anger fading on seeing his face becomes merely no longer being angry.

contexts.japanese: 貴方の顔見たら怒りも失せた
contexts.english: I'm not mad anymore

findings.description: Rin teasing him about romantic bragging becomes generic bragging about independent reasoning.
findings.sourceReading: のろけ is boasting about an intimate/romantic relationship; her response to his Sakura gratitude leads to his blush and protest.
findings.explanation: Rin teasing him about romantic bragging becomes generic bragging about independent reasoning.

contexts.japanese: もしかしてのろけ
contexts.english: you're bragging that you could have come to the same conclusion all on your own?

findings.description: Shirou’s panic over further physical closeness loses its named trigger.
findings.sourceReading: これ以上くっついたらすごいぞタイヘンだぞ names getting still closer as the threatened disaster before challenging her and demanding distance.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s panic over further physical closeness loses its named trigger.

contexts.japanese: これ以上くっついたらすごいぞタイヘンだぞ
contexts.english: S-s-s-s-s-stupid, k-knock it off!

findings.description: Losing hostile edge becomes merely being thrown for a loop.
findings.sourceReading: 毒気が抜かれた states that her malicious/hostile intent has drained away, explaining the abandoned morning business.
findings.explanation: Losing hostile edge becomes merely being thrown for a loop.

contexts.japanese: 正直、毒気が抜かれた
contexts.english: you threw me for a loop.

findings.description: Rin beginning to amuse herself by teasing him becomes having come solely to tease him.
findings.sourceReading: からかって遊ぶようになってき identifies a developing pattern after their actual strategy discussion; Shirou himself brought her to the roof.
findings.explanation: Rin beginning to amuse herself by teasing him becomes having come solely to tease him.

contexts.japanese: 俺をからかって遊ぶようになってきやがった
contexts.english: She only came here to push my buttons.

findings.description: Not coming as a guest on this visit becomes never having been here as a guest.
findings.sourceReading: 客として来訪したのではない defines her present status on entering uninvited.
findings.explanation: Not coming as a guest on this visit becomes never having been here as a guest.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は客として来訪したのではない
contexts.english: She's never been here as a guest.

findings.description: An outside enemy corrupting the Grail War becomes merely her enemies in it.
findings.sourceReading: 聖杯戦争を汚す外敵 explains her stated purpose as removal of an external contaminating force.
findings.explanation: An outside enemy corrupting the Grail War becomes merely her enemies in it.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯戦争を汚す外敵を排除しに
contexts.english: to eliminate her enemies in the Holy Grail War.

findings.description: Regret toward someone who has endured for over ten years becomes Rin bearing guilt for ten years.
findings.sourceReading: 十年以上も我慢し続けた modifies 誰か, the person toward whom Rin feels regret, following her wish to have come sooner.
findings.explanation: Regret toward someone who has endured for over ten years becomes Rin bearing guilt for ten years.

contexts.japanese: 十年以上も我慢し続けた、誰かに対する後悔だった
contexts.english: the guilt she's been bearing towards a certain someone for the last ten years.

findings.description: The pain of an engraved Magic Crest becomes simply the Crest engraved in her arm.
findings.sourceReading: 刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み is one of Rin’s specific remembered hardships.
findings.explanation: The pain of an engraved Magic Crest becomes simply the Crest engraved in her arm.

contexts.japanese: 刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み
contexts.english: the Magic Crest engraved in her arm.

findings.description: Being exceptional enough that the Association wants to welcome her becomes personal induction.
findings.sourceReading: 特待生として迎え入れようとするほど describes prospective recruitment as a specially admitted student.
findings.explanation: Being exceptional enough that the Association wants to welcome her becomes personal induction.

contexts.japanese: 魔術協会が特待生として迎え入れようとするほど
contexts.english: personally inducted into the Mage's Association as a prodigy.

findings.description: Swallowing her answer becomes eating her words.
findings.sourceReading: 言葉を飲むしかない means falling silent when asked whether she could endure being the insects’ plaything.
findings.explanation: Swallowing her answer becomes eating her words.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は言葉を飲むしかない
contexts.english: She could only eat her words

findings.description: Rin’s personally emanating murderous intent becomes a fierce air.
findings.sourceReading: 純粋に、遠坂凛という少女が放つ殺意 distinguishes fear of her actual intent to kill from fear of her Servant-backed Master status.
findings.explanation: Rin’s personally emanating murderous intent becomes a fierce air.

contexts.japanese: 少女が放つ殺意
contexts.english: the fierce air she's giving off.

findings.description: Hesitating over words becomes saying a wrong word.
findings.sourceReading: 下手に言い淀めば makes stalled disclosure the risk in Rin’s dangerous mood.
findings.explanation: Hesitating over words becomes saying a wrong word.

contexts.japanese: 下手に言い淀めば
contexts.english: if he says one wrong word.

findings.description: The indispensable disposition in which Shirou is unsurpassed becomes refusing to let himself lose.
findings.sourceReading: それだけは他の誰にも負けない identifies the one quality where he is unsurpassed; Rin subsequently defines it as other-directed striving and self-hatred.
findings.explanation: The indispensable disposition in which Shirou is unsurpassed becomes refusing to let himself lose.

contexts.japanese: それだけは他の誰にも負けない、彼が一番たり得るところよ
contexts.english: he won't let himself lose to anyone.

findings.description: Only being able to watch her leave becomes being unable even to see her.
findings.sourceReading: 去っていく遠坂凛を見つめる事しかできない describes his immobilized watching, with the next sentence explaining why he cannot attack.
findings.explanation: Only being able to watch her leave becomes being unable even to see her.

contexts.japanese: 去っていく遠坂凛を見つめる事しかできない
contexts.english: can't even see the departing Rin anymore.

findings.description: Rin's explanation loses the excessive self-love that she says produces Shinji's contempt. The contrast with her preceding description of self-hatred is consequently less explicit.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says excessive love of himself led Shinji to look down on others, whose superiority then trapped him in inferiority. This follows her description of a disposition involving self-hatred.
findings.explanation: Rin's explanation loses the excessive self-love that she says produces Shinji's contempt. The contrast with her preceding description of self-hatred is consequently less explicit.

contexts.japanese: 自分が好きなあまり周りを下に見たものの
contexts.english: You scorn everything around you

findings.description: Believing he is full inside becomes believing he is stuck.
findings.sourceReading: 詰まっている contrasts supposed inner substance with the preceding empty interior and following inflated balloon.
findings.explanation: Believing he is full inside becomes believing he is stuck.

contexts.japanese: 詰まっているように思えるのは本人だけ
contexts.english: You're the only one who thinks you're stuck

findings.description: That is precisely why disappears from her answer to his anger denial.
findings.sourceReading: だから、です follows his I’m angry and makes that lively anger part of why he looked happy; 自分で気付いてない then names his unawareness.
findings.explanation: That is precisely why disappears from her answer to his anger denial.

contexts.japanese: ……だから、です。先輩、自分で気付いてない
contexts.english: You didn't notice, then.

findings.description: Being liable to mistake her for a model student despite knowing her nature becomes immunity to being fooled because he knows.
findings.sourceReading: 本性を知ってるのに、優等生だって騙されかねない says the disguise is so convincing it might fool even him.
findings.explanation: Being liable to mistake her for a model student despite knowing her nature becomes immunity to being fooled because he knows.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の本性を知ってるのに、優等生だって騙されかねない
contexts.english: I know who you really are, so you can't fool me with that overachiever image.

findings.description: Actual earlier scolding becomes an imagined future response.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura reports that her sister got angry when she tried to continue working; the following recollection confirms that intervention.
findings.explanation: Actual earlier scolding becomes an imagined future response.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんがふざけるなって怒るんです
contexts.english: But I'm sure that'll make my sister upset, too.

findings.description: Anticipated reproach for daytime intimacy becomes a new future living-room encounter.
findings.sourceReading: He fears next-door witnesses despising what they are doing in broad daylight.
findings.explanation: Anticipated reproach for daytime intimacy becomes a new future living-room encounter.

contexts.japanese: 昼間っから何してるんだって軽蔑される
contexts.english: the next time we're in the living room.

findings.description: A recalled question about Sakura’s happiness becomes Sakura observing Shirou’s happiness.
findings.sourceReading: The quoted 嬉しいかって is the question he asked about her feeling at Rin’s stay, identified by31 and repeated to her in32.
findings.explanation: A recalled question about Sakura’s happiness becomes Sakura observing Shirou’s happiness.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんがここで寝泊りするようになって嬉しいかって
contexts.english: I said that you looked happy when she decided to sleep over.

contexts.japanese: 桜にとって今の状況がどんなものなのか、それを聞いていたんだっけ
contexts.english: I was listening to Sakura talk about our current living situation.

findings.description: Feeling blamed by her sister and herself becomes being scolded by her sister regardless of either’s actions.
findings.sourceReading: Both 姉さんにも自分にも are perceived sources of accusation; 気がして preserves Sakura’s feeling rather than authenticating Rin’s blame.
findings.explanation: Feeling blamed by her sister and herself becomes being scolded by her sister regardless of either’s actions.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんにも自分にも、何をしてるんだって責められてる気がして
contexts.english: no matter what she or I do, it ends up with her scolding me.

findings.description: The sisters’ mutual watching becomes Sakura alone watching Rin.
findings.sourceReading: わたしたちはお互い establishes reciprocal attention at a distance.
findings.explanation: The sisters’ mutual watching becomes Sakura alone watching Rin.

contexts.japanese: わたしたちはお互いを遠くからよく見てた
contexts.english: I fixated on it, and often watched her from afar.

findings.description: The English assigns Sakura’s blush to Tohsaka, who is next door, and changes Sakura’s murmuring into uneasy glances.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura blushes and murmurs her reply to Shirou; Rin is in the adjacent room.
findings.explanation: The English assigns Sakura’s blush to Tohsaka, who is next door, and changes Sakura’s murmuring into uneasy glances.

contexts.japanese: 桜は頬を赤らめてごにょごにょと口にする
contexts.english: Tohsaka blushes and looks around uneasily too

findings.description: Rin's observation that the scene has not been cleaned becomes a claim that Zouken cannot clean it. Her conclusion that he was absent survives, but its stated evidential basis changes.
findings.sourceReading: Rin points to the unfinished cleanup as evidence that Zouken was absent: he would not have left body parts behind.
findings.explanation: Rin's observation that the scene has not been cleaned becomes a claim that Zouken cannot clean it. Her conclusion that he was absent survives, but its stated evidential basis changes.

contexts.japanese: 後片付けが出来てないでしょ
contexts.english: Because he can't clean this up.

findings.description: No time to work leisurely becomes needing to concentrate.
findings.sourceReading: 悠長にやってる余裕なんてない specifies urgency and no slack.
findings.explanation: No time to work leisurely becomes needing to concentrate.

contexts.japanese: 悠長にやってる余裕なんてない
contexts.english: I can't afford to not concentrate on this.

findings.description: A servile mindset becomes being a coward.
findings.sourceReading: 卑屈な考え rebukes submission/self-abasement toward her abuser.
findings.explanation: A servile mindset becomes being a coward.

contexts.japanese: その卑屈な考え止めなさい
contexts.english: Stop being such a coward.

findings.description: Rin canceling her proposed switch installation becomes warning Shirou not to flip a switch.
findings.sourceReading: She had proposed installing a circuit switch and now cancels that plan because making easy on/off possible would endanger him.
findings.explanation: Rin canceling her proposed switch installation becomes warning Shirou not to flip a switch.

contexts.japanese: この前は士郎の体にスイッチをいれようって言ってたけど、アレは止めるわ
contexts.english: You've talked about flipping a switch in your body before, but don't do that this time.

contexts.japanese: ここで簡単に魔術回路の開閉ができるようになったら
contexts.english: You'll be in danger if you open and close your Magic Circuits carelessly.

findings.description: The current palm on his abdomen becomes the earlier palm on his chest, with added digging around.
findings.sourceReading: 腹に当てられた手 is current abdominal contact, already hard to bear; a small rodlike object passes through skin into his body.
findings.explanation: The current palm on his abdomen becomes the earlier palm on his chest, with added digging around.

contexts.japanese: 腹に当てられた遠坂の手の平だけでも耐えられない
contexts.english: Tohsaka's palm on my chest was unbearable enough, but now something small and stick-like is under my skin, digging around inside my body...!

findings.description: Fleeing revealing his own attraction becomes making Rin more self-conscious.
findings.sourceReading: Running away would make it look even more as though HE is conscious of Rin, leaving him no excuse.
findings.explanation: Fleeing revealing his own attraction becomes making Rin more self-conscious.

contexts.japanese: そんなコトをしたらますます遠坂を意識しているようで
contexts.english: it'll just make Tohsaka more self-conscious

findings.description: A posture instruction becomes a resilience idiom.
findings.sourceReading: 胸張って tells him to hold his chest out for the shoulder stage of the procedure.
findings.explanation: A posture instruction becomes a resilience idiom.

contexts.japanese: ちゃんと胸張ってよ
contexts.english: Come on, suck it up.

findings.description: Sakura rebuking his fluster at her sister becomes Sakura rebuking herself.
findings.sourceReading: As his girlfriend she says it is wrong for HIM to get flustered around her sister;39 explicitly asks him to restrain it.
findings.explanation: Sakura rebuking his fluster at her sister becomes Sakura rebuking herself.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんにドキマギするのおかしいですっ
contexts.english: I'm just being weird for letting my sister get to my head!

findings.description: Rin immediately correcting Sakura’s errors becomes Sakura worrying she has erred.
findings.sourceReading: 桜が何か失敗するとすぐ注意をする keeps Rin as the correcting actor; her constant attention under brusqueness is then inferred.
findings.explanation: Rin immediately correcting Sakura’s errors becomes Sakura worrying she has erred.

contexts.japanese: 桜が何か失敗するとすぐ注意をする
contexts.english: Sakura immediately worries she's done something wrong.

findings.description: Normally disregarding others’ circumstances becomes being open and unreserved.
findings.sourceReading: 人の事情なんてお構いなし contrasts ordinary uninhibited disregard with special romantic/familial reserve here.
findings.explanation: Normally disregarding others’ circumstances becomes being open and unreserved.

contexts.japanese: 普段は人の事情なんてお構いなし
contexts.english: usually so open and unreserved

findings.description: Not being able to do everything Rin can becomes not being able to do anything as she can.
findings.sourceReading: なんでもできるワケじゃない denies all-capability, not all competence.
findings.explanation: Not being able to do everything Rin can becomes not being able to do anything as she can.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんみたいになんでもできるワケじゃない
contexts.english: I can't do anything like she can.

findings.description: Mutual sisterly love becomes thinking well of each other.
findings.sourceReading: 相思相愛 emphatically assures mutual affection in a sister relationship, not romance.
findings.explanation: Mutual sisterly love becomes thinking well of each other.

contexts.japanese: 間違いなく相思相愛
contexts.english: both of you think well of each other.

findings.description: Tearing lettuce becomes cutting it.
findings.sourceReading: ちぎって tells her to tear lettuce for presentation.
findings.explanation: Tearing lettuce becomes cutting it.

contexts.japanese: レタスをちぎってください
contexts.english: please cut that lettuce

findings.description: Never having been called that becomes generic surprise at hearing it.
findings.sourceReading: そんなふうに呼ばれた事がない gives Rin’s claimed lack of prior experience as her face-saving reason.
findings.explanation: Never having been called that becomes generic surprise at hearing it.

contexts.japanese: そんなふうに呼ばれた事がないから驚いただけ
contexts.english: I was just surprised to hear it.

findings.description: An apparent secret ingredient explaining difference becomes an unless exception.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says it differs because something like a hidden seasoning is in it; her uncertainty concerns the ingredient’s character.
findings.explanation: An apparent secret ingredient explaining difference becomes an unless exception.

contexts.japanese: 隠し味らしきものが入ってるから他のとは違う
contexts.english: Unless there's some secret ingredient that makes this one different from the rest.

findings.description: Neither having room for serious discussion becomes Shirou not being in the mood.
findings.sourceReading: お互い……余裕なんてない concerns their mutual lack of room to discuss amid danger.
findings.explanation: Neither having room for serious discussion becomes Shirou not being in the mood.

contexts.japanese: お互い真剣に話し合う余裕なんてない
contexts.english: I'm not in the mood even for a serious talk

findings.description: Not like Tohsaka becomes so like Tohsaka.
findings.sourceReading: 遠坂らしくない describes her unusually strained performance compared with normally effortless dismissals.
findings.explanation: Not like Tohsaka becomes so like Tohsaka.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂らしくない
contexts.english: That's so like Tohsaka.

findings.description: Reported treatment as an accident becomes not treating it as an accident.
findings.sourceReading: 事件じゃなく事故 explicitly contrasts criminal incident with accident in the public treatment she reports.
findings.explanation: Reported treatment as an accident becomes not treating it as an accident.

contexts.japanese: 世間じゃ事件じゃなく事故って扱いみたい
contexts.english: They aren't treating it as an accident.

findings.description: Which body parts are missing becomes where the bodies are.
findings.sourceReading: 体の何処がなくなった concerns absent bodily portions along with identities.
findings.explanation: Which body parts are missing becomes where the bodies are.

contexts.japanese: 誰が死んで体の何処がなくなったのか
contexts.english: who died or where the bodies are

findings.description: Smiling at Shirou’s house becomes smiling only at that house.
findings.sourceReading: あなたの家だと笑う identifies the surprising happy behavior there without exclusive location.
findings.explanation: Smiling at Shirou’s house becomes smiling only at that house.

contexts.japanese: あなたの家だと笑う
contexts.english: She only smiles when she's at your place.

findings.description: Greatest surprise since yesterday becomes greatest surprise yesterday.
findings.sourceReading: 昨日から includes the period from yesterday through now.
findings.explanation: Greatest surprise since yesterday becomes greatest surprise yesterday.

contexts.japanese: 昨日から何が驚いたか
contexts.english: what surprised me the most yesterday.

findings.description: Unnecessary prior worry becomes having always worried.
findings.sourceReading: 取りこし苦労だった identifies a fear that proves unfounded after learning Sakura smiles with him.
findings.explanation: Unnecessary prior worry becomes having always worried.

contexts.japanese: わたしの取りこし苦労だった
contexts.english: I was always worried about that.

findings.description: Rin’s near-daily archery-club watching becomes Sakura hanging around the club.
findings.sourceReading: わたし governs her watching whenever free; since Sakura entered her school, Rin visited the club almost daily to observe her.
findings.explanation: Rin’s near-daily archery-club watching becomes Sakura hanging around the club.

contexts.japanese: あの子がわたしと同じ学園に入ってからは毎日のように弓道部に入り浸ってた
contexts.english: She's been hanging around the kyudo club ever since we ended up in the same school.

findings.description: Their discovering the meeting being bad for them becomes the meeting being unfair to them.
findings.sourceReading: それを知られるのは……良くはない specifically concerns the girls learning of it, explaining why he must return unnoticed.
findings.explanation: Their discovering the meeting being bad for them becomes the meeting being unfair to them.

contexts.japanese: それを知られるのは遠坂にも
contexts.english: It isn't fair to Tohsaka or the sleeping Sakura.

findings.description: Wanting to reset becomes wanting to relax.
findings.sourceReading: 仕切り直す is restarting/changing the course, her defensive excuse after stopping the news and bringing tea.
findings.explanation: Wanting to reset becomes wanting to relax.

contexts.japanese: わたしが仕切り直したかっただけ
contexts.english: I just wanted to relax for a bit.

findings.description: Rin’s self-mockery for watching disappears.
findings.sourceReading: やっぱりバカみたいに眺めてた repeats idiot-like for her own watching, alongside his repeated impossible attempts.
findings.explanation: Rin’s self-mockery for watching disappears.

contexts.japanese: やっぱりバカみたいに眺めてた
contexts.english: I saw some boy at the edge of campus trying over and over to jump a bar that was too high for him, like a moron.

findings.description: Thawed or even further frozen becomes melted then frozen again.
findings.sourceReading: 氷解したようなさらに凍結したような gives contradictory uncertain impressions of the newly explained hostility.
findings.explanation: Thawed or even further frozen becomes melted then frozen again.

contexts.japanese: 氷解したようなさらに凍結したような
contexts.english: one mystery has been melted, only to be frozen again.

findings.description: One chance sighting becomes repeated sightings.
findings.sourceReading: たまたま a nonmember came while she regularly watched the club; seeing his face then triggers recognition.
findings.explanation: One chance sighting becomes repeated sightings.

contexts.japanese: たまたまね、部員でもないのにやってきたヤツがいて
contexts.english: sometimes, I saw this guy there that wasn't even part of the club.

findings.description: Not belittling herself becomes not speaking out of humility.
findings.sourceReading: 卑下してはいない counters her terrible-person description by denying self-disparagement.
findings.explanation: Not belittling herself becomes not speaking out of humility.

contexts.japanese: 自分を卑下してはいない
contexts.english: Tohsaka isn't saying this out of humility.

findings.description: Single-minded purity becomes a simpler life.
findings.sourceReading: 純粋 praises the purity of dedicating oneself without calculating outcomes.
findings.explanation: Single-minded purity becomes a simpler life.

contexts.japanese: どんなに純粋な事なんだろう
contexts.english: Life would probably be a lot simpler

findings.description: Standing as if saying the break is over becomes an actual declaration.
findings.sourceReading: と言うかのように qualifies her action as conveying the end of the break without a specified spoken declaration.
findings.explanation: Standing as if saying the break is over becomes an actual declaration.

contexts.japanese: 休憩は終わりだ、と言うかのように
contexts.english: stands up and declares that break time is over.

findings.description: Not knowing what happened last night loses night.
findings.sourceReading: 昨日の夜 locates the unknown damaging event specifically at night.
findings.explanation: Not knowing what happened last night loses night.

contexts.japanese: 昨日の夜何があったのかは知らない
contexts.english: I don't know what happened to her yesterday.

findings.description: Being torn apart by feeding worms becomes heavy feeding.
findings.sourceReading: 食いちぎられた is tearing flesh away by biting, paired with the alternative of another agent slicing her up.
findings.explanation: Being torn apart by feeding worms becomes heavy feeding.

contexts.japanese: 体内の刻印虫に食いちぎられた
contexts.english: the Crest Worms have been feeding heavily

findings.description: Sakura repeatedly voicing her true feelings becomes simply starting to say the examples.
findings.sourceReading: 本音を立て続けに assigns unguarded true feelings to her successive greetings/wishes as Rin reads them.
findings.explanation: Sakura repeatedly voicing her true feelings becomes simply starting to say the examples.

contexts.japanese: 本音を立て続けに言われた時
contexts.english: when she started saying things like

findings.description: Repeated recollection again loses Rin’s self-mocking watcher.
findings.sourceReading: やっぱりバカみたい applies to her watching, not just his attempt.
findings.explanation: Repeated recollection again loses Rin’s self-mocking watcher.

contexts.japanese: やっぱりバカみたいに眺めてた
contexts.english: I saw some boy at the edge of campus trying over and over to jump a bar that was too high for him, like a moron.

findings.description: Her treasured rarity being diminished becomes Rin actively treating it as ordinary.
findings.sourceReading: The memory loses rarity as she learns Rin also saw it, in Sakura’s wounded perception.
