findings.explanation: Azoth modeled on jeweled sword becomes found similar blade.

contexts.japanese: 出来るだけ宝石剣に似せたアゾット剣と、士郎の投影とイリヤのサポート。うまくいけばオリジナルの複製とはいかないけど、半分ぐらいは能力の再現ができる筈よ」
contexts.english: I did my best to find you an Azoth Blade similar to the Jeweled Sword, and Illya will be supporting your Projection. If this goes well, we won't be able to replicate the original, but we should get something with about half of its power."

findings.description: Return to room becomes return to Rin's own room.
findings.sourceReading: Rin proposes returning to a calm room and immediately turns toward the living room.
findings.explanation: Return to room becomes return to Rin's own room.

contexts.japanese: 「そうね。それじゃ部屋に戻りましょう。落ち着いた場所じゃないと成功率が落ちるでしょ」
contexts.english: "Yeah. Let's go back to my room, then. You need a quiet place for the best chance of success."

contexts.japanese: ほら、と居間に足を向ける遠坂。
contexts.english: Tohsaka beckons us to follow her to the living room.

findings.description: Crucial-moment clumsiness becomes highest comparative likelihood.
findings.sourceReading: Her lack of rebuttal suggests she cannot deny possible mistakes at the crucial moment.
findings.explanation: Crucial-moment clumsiness becomes highest comparative likelihood.

contexts.japanese: 反論しないあたり、本人もここ一番でドジをかます可能性を否定できないらしい。
contexts.english: But she doesn't deny that she's the person most likely to make careless mistakes.

findings.description: Multidimensional refraction loses refraction.
findings.sourceReading: Formal description is 多重次元屈折現象, multidimensional refraction phenomenon.
findings.explanation: Multidimensional refraction loses refraction.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。正しく言うのなら多重次元屈折現象、宝石剣キシュア・ゼルレッチ・シュバインオーグ。
contexts.english: "Yeah. To be exact, it's the Multi-Dimensional Phenomenon: Jeweled Sword Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg.

findings.description: Trial use becomes trying something.
findings.sourceReading: Rin and Illya plan a trial firing or test of the new weapon and ask boy to rest.
findings.explanation: Trial use becomes trying something.

contexts.japanese: 「遠坂、じゃないわよ。わたしとイリヤは試し打ちをしてくるから、士郎は少しでも体を休めて—って、どうしたのよその手……！」
contexts.english: "Don't give me that. Illya and I are going to try something, so settle down and—hey, what's happened to your hand!?"

findings.description: Involuntary consciousness interruption becomes deliberate disconnection.
findings.sourceReading: Consciousness breaks, and before he knows it Rin has taken his bloody hand despite seeming slow.
findings.explanation: Involuntary consciousness interruption becomes deliberate disconnection.

contexts.japanese: 意識が断線して、いつのまにか血塗れの右手を掴まれていた。
contexts.english: I disconnect my mind and realize that she's holding my bloody right hand.

findings.description: Unassuming accessory becomes everyday sight.
findings.sourceReading: Pendant is small or modest for a jewel-user like Rin and can accent her beauty.
findings.explanation: Unassuming accessory becomes everyday sight.

contexts.japanese: 宝石使いである遠坂にはこじんまりとした物だが、遠坂は美人なんだから、こういう小物の方が本人を引き立たせていいと思う。
contexts.english: To a jewel-user like Tohsaka, this is probably an everyday sight. But she's so pretty, I bet an accessory like this would really liven her up.

findings.description: Negligible remaining amount becomes below every use threshold.
findings.sourceReading: Boy's pendant retains a little insignificant mana, and its having been used is meaningful.
findings.explanation: Negligible remaining amount becomes below every use threshold.

contexts.japanese: 「違うわ。わたしのは空っぽだけど、士郎のは少しだけ残ってる。取るに足りない量だけど、それでも、使われたからには意味があるんだわ」
contexts.english: "No, they're not. Mine's empty, but yours still has a little left in it. It isn't enough to use for anything, but... It has meaning because it was used."

findings.description: Around dawn becomes before dawn.
findings.sourceReading: Illya asks him to return with Sakura and Rin around when night gives way to dawn.
findings.explanation: Around dawn becomes before dawn.

contexts.japanese: 「いってらっしゃいシロウ。夜が明ける頃に、サクラとリンと三人で帰ってきてね」
contexts.english: "Good luck, Shirou. Come home with Sakura and Rin before dawn, okay?"

findings.description: Finest feast becomes an appetizer.
findings.sourceReading: The ingredient/person Shirou brought was the finest feast, in her grotesque meal metaphor.
findings.explanation: Finest feast becomes an appetizer.

contexts.japanese: —ごちそうさま先輩。先輩が連れてきてくれた食材は、最高のご馳走でした」
contexts.english: Thank you for the meal, Senpai. You brought me the most delicious appetizer."

findings.description: Instruction to go and hold Rin's hand becomes Sakura's placement and permission.
findings.sourceReading: After reporting Rin's repeated pleas, Sakura tells Shirou to go beside her and hold her hand.
findings.explanation: Instruction to go and hold Rin's hand becomes Sakura's placement and permission.

contexts.japanese: 「姉さんったら、さっきから先輩に助けを求めてばっかりなんだもの。すぐ傍にいって、手でも握ってあげてくださいね」
contexts.english: "Silly Nee-san. She started begging you for help. I'll put you right next to her, where you can even hold hands."

findings.description: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.
findings.sourceReading: Tiny pendant has just one breath of mana; insufficient for much, but helps him extend his hand.
findings.explanation: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.

contexts.japanese: 何の役にも立たない、けれど、手を伸ばすぐらいは助けてくれる、小さな小さなペンダント。
contexts.english: It's completely useless, but the small, small pendant will make sure that someone saves me if I reach out with my hand.

contexts.japanese: ほんの一呼吸分の魔力。
contexts.english: One breath of magical energy.

findings.description: Surface Master gate and underground Greater Grail distinction disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Rin explains surface site is a gate for Masters who merely want Grail, while to reach the Greater Grail, source of the war, they must go down rather than up.
findings.explanation: Surface Master gate and underground Greater Grail distinction disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「いえ、柳洞寺に用はないわ。上で作られてる場は表向きの、ただ聖杯を欲しがるマスター用の門よ。……聖杯戦争の大聖杯に行こうっていうんなら、上じゃなくて下に行かないとね」
contexts.english: "No, we're not going to the temple. The compound up top was built just for show, for the benefit of Masters seeking the Holy Grail."

findings.description: Three intruders become both.
findings.sourceReading: Saber could face all three: Rin, Shirou and Rider, alone.
findings.explanation: Three intruders become both.

contexts.japanese: 桜を守る最強のサーヴァントであるセイバーなら、一人きりで俺たち三人の相手が出来る。
contexts.english: She's the strongest Servant protecting Sakura, and she could take us both alone.

contexts.japanese: 「士郎、貴方は後ろに。指示通り、セイバーの相手は私がします」
contexts.english: "Shirou, get behind me. I will engage Saber, as planned."

findings.description: Rin holding Sakura off becomes Rin settling score.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou takes encouragement as telling him to arrive while Rin can still keep Sakura held off.
findings.explanation: Rin holding Sakura off becomes Rin settling score.

contexts.japanese: 要するにあいつは、自分が桜を止めておけるうちに来いと、遠まわしに応援してくれたのだ。
contexts.english: In other words, telling me to come before she settles the score with Sakura was her roundabout way of cheering me on.

findings.description: Hypothetical worldwide mage drain becomes actual gathering to use reserve.
findings.sourceReading: Even all mages worldwide gathering and drawing freely would not exhaust store.
findings.explanation: Hypothetical worldwide mage drain becomes actual gathering to use reserve.

contexts.japanese: 世界中の魔術師がここに集まって、好き勝手魔力をくみ上げようと尽きない貯蔵量。
contexts.english: an inexhaustible resource that mages from around the world gather here to use.

findings.description: Humans' need to play becomes victim lives empty until Sakura plays with them.
findings.sourceReading: Ruby reads crushing as playing: humans find daily life boring and meaningless without play and suffer thirst without drinking. Sakura uses normal human needs to normalize her crushing and swallowing.
findings.explanation: Humans' need to play becomes victim lives empty until Sakura plays with them.

contexts.japanese: 人間は潰していないと毎日がつまらなくて意味がないし、飲まないと渇いて苦しいでしょう？
contexts.english: Humans live such boring, pointless lives before I play with them. And I get thirsty, too.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。だって、人を潰すのも呑み込むのも変わらないもの。
contexts.english: "Yes. After all, crushing people isn't any different from swallowing them.

contexts.japanese: ほら、だから同じ。姉さんと変わらない。わたしは当たり前のように、みんながしているコトをするだけです」
contexts.english: See? I'm just like you, Nee-san. I'm just doing what everyone else does."

findings.description: Going murder omits infinitive to.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks whether Sakura intends to kill Shirou too.
findings.explanation: Going murder omits infinitive to.

contexts.japanese: 「……そ。で、目に付くものなら片っ端から八つ当たりするワケか。けど士郎はどうなの。あいつは今でもアンタを助けられると信じてる。それでも関係なく、アンタはあいつをやっちゃう気？」
contexts.english: "...Okay. So you're going to take your anger out on anyone you see. But what about Shirou? He still thinks that he can save you. Are you going murder him, too?"

findings.description: Cup-of-Heaven threat loses this-me self-identification.
findings.sourceReading: 天の杯 bears このわたし ruby: she tells Rin to drown in this me, identifying engulfing vessel with herself.
findings.explanation: Cup-of-Heaven threat loses this-me self-identification.

contexts.japanese: 今度は誰も助けに来ない。湖に落ちた虫みたいに、天の杯に溺れなさい」
contexts.english: No one's coming to save you this time. Drown in the Cup of Heaven, like a bug fallen into a lake."

findings.description: Volley becomes maximum firepower.
findings.sourceReading: 一斉射撃 is simultaneous shooting/a volley.
findings.explanation: Volley becomes maximum firepower.

contexts.japanese: 「Es läßt frei.Eilesalve—！」
contexts.english: "Es lässt frei. Eilesalve! (Release, maximum firepower!)"

findings.description: Sakura's attrition attack assigned to Rin.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Sakura continues attacking until Rin's stamina ends, cave collapse afterward means Sakura loses.
findings.explanation: Sakura's attrition attack assigned to Rin.

contexts.japanese: 仮に、遠坂凛の体力が尽きるまで攻め続けたとしても、その後に待つものは洞窟の崩壊なのだ。
contexts.english: Even if Rin were to attack until her physical strength failed her, the cave would collapse after.

contexts.japanese: このまま徒に戦いを続けては間桐桜の敗北となる。
contexts.english: Continuing this vain battle would mean failure for Sakura.

findings.description: Self-defeating continued action becomes comprehension strangling her.
findings.sourceReading: Despite knowing attacks are pointless and strangle her own prospects, Sakura keeps screaming.
findings.explanation: Self-defeating continued action becomes comprehension strangling her.

contexts.japanese: 無意味と知りながら、自らの首を絞めると理解していながら、間桐桜は叫び続ける。
contexts.english: Sakura screams, knowing it's pointless, the comprehension wringing her neck.

findings.description: No human treatment for a long time becomes nobody ever treated her as human.
findings.sourceReading: She says she has long ceased to receive human treatment, then describes bodily alteration.
findings.explanation: No human treatment for a long time becomes nobody ever treated her as human.

contexts.japanese: 当然です、わたしはもうずっと前から人間扱いされてこなかった。目も髪も姉さんとは変わっていって、細胞の隅々までマキリの魔術師になるよう変えられた……！」
contexts.english: Of course I did. Because nobody's ever treated me like one. My hair and my eyes stopped looking like yours. They changed me into a Makiri mage down to my very cells...!"

findings.description: Crying girl/shadow clinging toward Rin becomes shadows clinging to the crying girl.
findings.sourceReading: Rin silently cuts down the crying, imploring girl with shadow ruby; image overlays pleading Sakura and her approaching shadow.
findings.explanation: Crying girl/shadow clinging toward Rin becomes shadows clinging to the crying girl.

contexts.japanese: 泣いて縋ってくる少女を、彼女は無言で斬り伏せる。
contexts.english: Rin cuts away the shadows clinging to the crying girl.

findings.description: Sakura nearly refusing combat becomes Sakura denied a proper fight.
findings.sourceReading: Overwhelmed by sister, girl was on point of refusing the fight before despair renews curses.
findings.explanation: Sakura nearly refusing combat becomes Sakura denied a proper fight.

contexts.japanese: 姉に圧され、戦いを拒否しかけていた少女は、絶望と共に呪いを具現化させていく。
contexts.english: Driven back by her sister and denied even a proper fight, the girl materializes more curses in her despair.

findings.description: Qualities Sakura wanted Rin to have become things Sakura never had.
findings.sourceReading: Continuing address to Rin: you lack even fragment of what I wanted you to possess, yet insist you alone remain clean.
findings.explanation: Qualities Sakura wanted Rin to have become things Sakura never had.

contexts.japanese: 持っていて欲しかったものを一欠片も持たないクセに、　自分だけはキレイなままだと言い張って—！
contexts.english: I've never had a single thing I wanted, but you just keep on insisting on how clean you are...!

contexts.japanese: わたしのコトなんて好きでも嫌いでもないクセに、
contexts.english: You don't care about me at all.

findings.description: Refusal to forgive that woman loses written layer.
findings.sourceReading: Base says not forgive that woman, while ruby reads sister and start of noisy/shut-up.
findings.explanation: Refusal to forgive that woman loses written layer.

contexts.japanese: —あの女は、許さない。
contexts.english: Shut up, Nee-san.

findings.description: Settling postponed decision becomes earlier determination to keep holding out.
findings.sourceReading: Rin now firms the decision she had postponed, ending wait for Shirou at limit.
findings.explanation: Settling postponed decision becomes earlier determination to keep holding out.

contexts.japanese: 先延ばしにしていた決意を固める。
contexts.english: She's been determined to hold out as long as possible.

contexts.japanese: 限界まで衛宮士郎を待とうとしたが、これ以上は延ばせない。
contexts.english: She waited for Shirou Emiya until the last possible moment, but she can't go on any longer.

findings.description: Critical moment realization becomes judgment that this was best thing to do.
findings.sourceReading: In the crucial last moment she suddenly realizes she cannot kill Sakura up close.
findings.explanation: Critical moment realization becomes judgment that this was best thing to do.

contexts.japanese: ようするにさっきの瞬間、ここ一番っていう時に気付いてしまった。
contexts.english: In that last moment, she just felt that this was the best thing to do.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜を間近で見た途端、自分には桜を殺せないなー、などと、当たり前のように感じてしまった。
contexts.english: Once she saw Sakura up close, she felt like, "I can't kill Sakura, huh..."

findings.description: Everything was there becomes everywhere she went wrong.
findings.sourceReading: After asking where error occurred she realizes everything she wanted was present right before her.
findings.explanation: Everything was there becomes everywhere she went wrong.

contexts.japanese: 全部あった。
contexts.english: Everywhere.

contexts.japanese: ……何処で、間違えてしまったのか。
contexts.english: ...Where did I go wrong?

contexts.japanese: あんなに欲しかったものが、本当はすぐ目の前にあった。
contexts.english: I wanted it so badly, but it was right in front of me all along.

findings.description: Answering why he advances becomes denial that the threatened event will happen.
findings.sourceReading: どうしても何もない dismisses her why-question and repeats his already stated purpose: take her out and save Rin.
findings.explanation: Answering why he advances becomes denial that the threatened event will happen.

contexts.japanese: 「どうしても何もない。桜をここから連れ出して、遠坂を助ける。さっきそう言っただろう、桜」
contexts.english: "That won't happen at all. I'm going to get you out of here and save Tohsaka. I already told you that, Sakura."

contexts.japanese: 「どうして言うこと聞いてくれないんですか……！？
contexts.english: "Why won't you do what I ask you to!?

findings.description: Unbearable casualties become shadow's limited capacity.
findings.sourceReading: Two successive days of hundred-person-scale harm would be intolerable for people/speaker.
findings.explanation: Unbearable casualties become shadow's limited capacity.

contexts.japanese: 「そうね。百人単位の被害なんて、二日続けておきたらたまらないもの」
contexts.english: "Yeah. It probably can't keep causing hundreds of victims for more than a couple of days in a row."

findings.description: Frame ready sometime today becomes whole-day work.
findings.sourceReading: Somehow frame will be ready within today, then Projection tonight.
findings.explanation: Frame ready sometime today becomes whole-day work.

contexts.japanese: 「だから、例の切り札の作成。なんとか今日中に骨組みが出来るから、今夜“投影”を実行するわ。
contexts.english: "Because you're going to make our secret weapon. We'll spend the entire day making the frame, and then Project it tonight.

findings.description: Confrontation upon successful Projection becomes weapon deciding whether they win.
findings.sourceReading: 成功次第臓硯と決着をつける: as soon as Projection succeeds, move to settling conflict with Zouken.
findings.explanation: Confrontation upon successful Projection becomes weapon deciding whether they win.

contexts.japanese: で、成功次第臓硯と決着をつける。これ以上犠牲者は増やせない。あの影がなんであれ、臓硯を倒せば聖杯戦争は終わる。得体の知れないあの影も、そうなったら消えるでしょ」
contexts.english: It's going to decide whether we win against Zouken. I'm not going to let any more innocent people get hurt. I have no idea what the Shadow is, but the Holy Grail War will end once we take out Zouken. That should cause the Shadow to disappear too."

findings.description: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.
findings.sourceReading: If his face is pale/ringed, even Sakura receiving care will feel obliged to worry about him.
findings.explanation: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.

contexts.japanese: ……まったく、嘘だと思うなら鏡を見てきなさい。顔面蒼白で目にクマ作ってたら、看病される桜だって気を遣うわ」
contexts.english: ...If you think I'm lying, go take a look in the mirror. You're deathly pale and got rings around your eyes like a raccoon. I'm doing you a favor by taking care of Sakura."

findings.description: Around a day unconscious becomes favor regretted next day.
findings.sourceReading: Imitating Rider can make him insensible for roughly a full day.
findings.explanation: Around a day unconscious becomes favor regretted next day.

contexts.japanese: ライダーの真似事でいいなら、まる一日前後不覚にしてあげられるけど？」
contexts.english: If you're okay with me copying what Rider did, I'll do you a favor that you'll regret the next day."

findings.description: Resentment at being bested becomes practice until satisfied.
findings.sourceReading: She wants practice because she cannot bear remaining on losing end of Rider encounter.
findings.explanation: Resentment at being bested becomes practice until satisfied.

contexts.japanese: おまえ、単にやられっぱなしじゃ気が済まないから練習したいだけだろ」
contexts.english: You just wanna practice on me until you're satisfied!"

findings.description: Sleeping for entire day becomes passing out in middle of day.
findings.sourceReading: If laid up asleep for a full day, cannot wake until tomorrow morning; conflicts with tonight's plan.
findings.explanation: Sleeping for entire day becomes passing out in middle of day.

contexts.japanese: 「やるかバカ！　そんな物騒な実験には付き合えないし、だいたい丸一日寝込んだら明日の朝まで起きられない」
contexts.english: "Hell no! I won't play along with your scary experiments, plus if I pass out in the middle of the day, I won't wake up until tomorrow."

findings.description: As soon as possible becomes as much as possible.
findings.sourceReading: Wants two girls back as sisters at earliest possible time.
findings.explanation: As soon as possible becomes as much as possible.

contexts.japanese: だからあの二人には少しでも早く姉妹に戻ってもらいたい。
contexts.english: That's why I want them to return to being sisters as much as possible.

findings.description: Possible casualties and risky draining become certain deaths and certain attack.
findings.sourceReading: 犠牲者が出るかも and 奪いかねない warn victims may occur and she could drain passersby, as school incident.
findings.explanation: Possible casualties and risky draining become certain deaths and certain attack.

contexts.japanese: 「犠牲者が出るかもね。学校でわたしを襲った時みたいに、目に付いた人から魔力を奪いかねないわ。
contexts.english: "More people will die. She'll suck up the magical energy from anyone around her, just like when she attacked me at school.

findings.description: Head tilt becomes looking up in surprise.
findings.sourceReading: Rin tilts head at entrance noise before window check.
findings.explanation: Head tilt becomes looking up in surprise.

contexts.japanese: 玄関からの物音に遠坂凛は首をかしげる。
contexts.english: The noise from the front door makes Rin Tohsaka look up in surprise.

findings.description: Supplies awaiting simultaneous medicine delivery become contrast with taking drug along.
findings.sourceReading: Had planned to carry pitcher/nightclothes together with medicine; because of that they remain undelivered, and temperature not yet measured.
findings.explanation: Supplies awaiting simultaneous medicine delivery become contrast with taking drug along.

contexts.japanese: 薬と一緒に持っていこう、と思っていたので水差しと寝巻きもまだ渡していないし、今朝は熱も計っていない。
contexts.english: At first she was going to take the drug with her, but she still hasn't given Sakura the water pitcher and pajamas, nor taken her temperature.

findings.description: Difficulty because boy is unaware becomes competitive danger accusation.
findings.sourceReading: What's troublesome is that he doesn't realize his weakened state, fool.
findings.explanation: Difficulty because boy is unaware becomes competitive danger accusation.

contexts.japanese: 「……なにが厄介かって、本人が気付いてないあたりが厄介なのよ、ばか」
contexts.english: "...And he calls me dangerous? You're the biggest danger because you're so clueless, dummy."

findings.description: Easy catch if running becomes urgent requirement.
findings.sourceReading: Anyway if she runs she can immediately catch up.
findings.explanation: Easy catch if running becomes urgent requirement.

contexts.japanese: ともあれ、走ればすぐに追いつける。
contexts.english: Anyway, she needs to catch up to him right away.

findings.description: Shirou helping Sakura and Sakura going alone become Rin helping Shirou and Shirou going alone.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura couldn't resolve it alone, so that guy tried to help; yet she went alone to resolve it after all. Conversation concerns Rider holding Rin until Sakura returns.
findings.explanation: Shirou helping Sakura and Sakura going alone become Rin helping Shirou and Shirou going alone.

contexts.japanese: 「—ほんとに頭きた。一人じゃ出来ないからあいつが助けようとしたのに、結局、一人で解決しにいくなんてね」
contexts.english: "I'm so annoyed. I was trying to help him because he can't do this on his own, but he's going to end up trying anyway."

findings.description: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Even otherwise Sakura already has one previous offense, so guarding Illya is natural for Rin.
findings.explanation: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.

contexts.japanese: 「まあね。わたしには士郎と違って、アンタを助ける理由がないもの。いよいよとなったらイリヤを攫いに来るのは明白でしょ。そうでなくても一度前科があるんだから、イリヤを見張るのは当然よ」
contexts.english: "Pretty much. Unlike Shirou, I don't have any reason to save you. It was obvious that you'd come to take Illya once things started rolling. Even if you didn't, you had plenty of reason to be cautious of her."

findings.description: Emotionless voice's chilling question becomes Rin taking it in stride.
findings.sourceReading: Question causes chill because Sakura's voice is emotionless; clause leads into Rin's firm response.
findings.explanation: Emotionless voice's chilling question becomes Rin taking it in stride.

contexts.japanese: それ故に寒気のする質問に、
contexts.english: Rin takes the question in stride.

contexts.japanese: 感情のない声。
contexts.english: Her voice contains no emotion.

findings.description: Not trusting to the end becomes never putting faith in protector.
findings.sourceReading: Failed to trust the man wanting to protect Sakura through to the end, by leaving.
findings.explanation: Not trusting to the end becomes never putting faith in protector.

contexts.japanese: 「あったりまえじゃない。この家を出た時点で救いきれない大馬鹿よ。アンタは間桐桜を守りたがってたヤツを、最後まで信じてやらなかったんだから」
contexts.english: "Obviously. You're a huge moron, beyond saving from the moment you left this house, because you never put any faith in the one guy who wanted to protect Sakura Matou."

findings.description: Rounded back becomes backing up.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura mocks sister hunching/rounding her back as seeming frightened.
findings.explanation: Rounded back becomes backing up.

contexts.japanese: 「……どうしたんですか姉さん。そんなふうに背中をまるめてると、まるで、わたしに怯えているように見えますよ？」
contexts.english: "...What's wrong, Nee-san? The way you're backing up almost makes you look like you're scared of me."

findings.description: Already too late from outset becomes never ready.
findings.sourceReading: No question of too late now: everything was already too late when Sakura reached for Illya.
findings.explanation: Already too late from outset becomes never ready.

contexts.japanese: 手遅れも何もない。
contexts.english: She was never ready to begin with.

contexts.japanese: そもそも間桐桜がイリヤスフィールに手を伸ばした時点で、もう、何もかもが手遅れだった。
contexts.english: From the moment Sakura reached for Illya, it was already over.

findings.description: Biting back an insult becomes enduring humiliation.
findings.sourceReading: Following interrupted you-little insult, Rin glares while suppressing insult she would utter.
findings.explanation: Biting back an insult becomes enduring humiliation.

contexts.japanese: 侮辱をかみ殺しながら、凛は桜を睨み返す。
contexts.english: Rin glares at Sakura, enduring the humiliation.
"You...little..."

findings.description: Less than a second becomes less than a few seconds.
findings.sourceReading: Meal takes not even one second, 秒もかからなかった.
findings.explanation: Less than a second becomes less than a few seconds.

contexts.japanese: 『食事』は、それこそ秒もかからなかった。
contexts.english: The "meal" doesn't even last a few seconds.

findings.description: Too lenient becomes too easy.
findings.sourceReading: Merely draining and neutralizing her would be 甘い, too soft/lenient in Sakura's self-persuasion to kill.
findings.explanation: Too lenient becomes too easy.

contexts.japanese: 魔力を奪って無力化したぐらいじゃ甘い。
contexts.english: It would be too easy to simply neutralize her by taking her energy.

findings.description: Control within seconds becomes holding control for seconds, impossibility becomes miracle.
findings.sourceReading: Gaining Grail control within merely seconds is madness; alone boy cannot accomplish it under any circumstances.
findings.explanation: Control within seconds becomes holding control for seconds, impossibility becomes miracle.

contexts.japanese: それだけではない。わずか数秒で聖杯を制御するなど狂気の沙汰だ。おまえ一人では、どうあっても成しえない奇跡だぞ」
contexts.english: That's not all. It would be a mind-shattering task to control the Holy Grail for even a few seconds. Such a feat would be a miracle for you alone."

findings.description: Present imagined defeats become promised future victories matching old fantasies.
findings.sourceReading: She defeats those who threatened her within present imagination; next joy in imagined acts.
findings.explanation: Present imagined defeats become promised future victories matching old fantasies.

contexts.japanese: 少女は自らを脅かし続けたモノたちを想像の中で倒していく。
contexts.english: She'll defeat everyone who's threatened her, just as she always imagined.

contexts.japanese: そのイメージ、想像上の行為だけで歓喜に満たされる。
contexts.english: The thought alone fills her with unexpected joy.

findings.description: The speaker's ability to touch Rin becomes the mud's ability to touch her.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou can touch Rin although he cannot remove her mud covering; 俺 understood from the voiced attempt and lifted Rin at page3.
findings.explanation: The speaker's ability to touch Rin becomes the mud's ability to touch her.

contexts.japanese: 「っ……！　なんだこれ、遠坂には触れるのに、どうして……！」
contexts.english: "Rrgh...! What it this!? It can touch Tohsaka, so why can't I...!?"

contexts.japanese: 抱き上げても返事はない。
contexts.english: I lift her up, but she doesn't respond.

findings.description: Irrecoverably disabling Rin is softened to neutralizing her.
findings.sourceReading: 再起不能 specifies making Rin unable to recover/get back up, alongside killing Shirou and absorbing Rider.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverably disabling Rin is softened to neutralizing her.

contexts.japanese: 「言葉通りの意味よ。ライダーを取り込んでもシロウを殺してもリンを再起不能にしても、今のサクラには意味がないってコト。時間の無駄だし、八つ当たりはそのあたりにしておいたら？」
contexts.english: "Exactly what I said. You can consume Rider, kill Shirou, and neutralize Rin, but it's pointless to you right now. You're just wasting time, so why don't you stop the temper tantrum already?"

findings.description: Rin still ends the deadlock first, but break the ice omits her release of her fighting stance. Both versions keep Shirou lowering his wooden sword after her request.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks Shirou to lower the sword and is the first to release her stance; he then lowers his wooden sword. The omitted detail is her physical de-escalation, not all of her initiative.
findings.explanation: Rin still ends the deadlock first, but break the ice omits her release of her fighting stance. Both versions keep Shirou lowering his wooden sword after her request.

contexts.japanese: ……先に構えを解いたのは遠坂だった。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's the first to break the ice.

contexts.japanese: 「……ちょっと。いいかげん、それ下げてくれない？　お化け屋敷じゃないんだから」
contexts.english: "...Hold on. Would you put that down? We're not in a haunted house."

contexts.japanese: 釣られて木刀を下げる。
contexts.english: I lower the wooden sword as asked.

findings.description: Shirou's objection to either girl being injured becomes a warning that Rin will be hurt. His explicit concern for Illya within this appeal disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou objects because either Rin or Illya will be injured if they fight.
findings.explanation: Shirou's objection to either girl being injured becomes a warning that Rin will be hurt. His explicit concern for Illya within this appeal disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「それもあるけど。遠坂、イリヤと戦ったらただじゃ済まないぞ。始めたらどっちかが必ず傷を負う。そういうのは嫌だ。俺は、もともと」
contexts.english: "That too. But Tohsaka, you won't get out unscathed if you fight her. You're bound to get hurt once you start. I don't want that to happen. To begin with—"

findings.description: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.
findings.sourceReading: As long as he serves as guide, Rin will give his plan priority; taking her keeps her from challenging Illya independently.
findings.explanation: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.

contexts.japanese: けどまあ、案内をする分には、遠坂は俺を優先してくれる。
contexts.english: Still, Tohsaka's doing me a favor by letting me guide her.

contexts.japanese: 放っておけばイリヤに戦いを挑む遠坂だが、ここで連れて行くと言えば、遠坂は大人しくしてくれるのだ。
contexts.english: If I let her go, she might fight Illya, but if she comes with me, then she'll behave.

findings.description: A mistaken tactical estimate becomes belief that he could change anything.
findings.sourceReading: His error was judging that the planned dash, hand-grab and sideways jump could somehow work.
findings.explanation: A mistaken tactical estimate becomes belief that he could change anything.

contexts.japanese: —どうにかなると、判断した事が間違いだった。
contexts.english: I was wrong to think I could change anything.

findings.description: A single prey in a web becomes every last prey.
findings.sourceReading: The Shadow mercilessly swallows prey caught in a spiderweb-like situation; metaphor does not enumerate victims.
findings.explanation: A single prey in a web becomes every last prey.

contexts.japanese: 蜘蛛の巣にかかった獲物を、容赦なく呑み込んだ。
contexts.english: swallowing every last prey within its web.

findings.description: The shared objective survives, but the English leaves out Rin's explicit limit: cooperating until Zouken is defeated.
findings.sourceReading: Rin offers cooperation until their shared objective of defeating Zouken is achieved.
findings.explanation: The shared objective survives, but the English leaves out Rin's explicit limit: cooperating until Zouken is defeated.

contexts.japanese: だいたいね、貴方だけじゃ心許ないでしょ。臓硯を倒すって目的は一緒なんだし、それまで手を組んであげてもいいってコト！」
contexts.english: I bet you aren't feeling great about fighting alone, either. We both want to take down Zouken, so I'll team up with you if that's what you want!"

contexts.japanese: 「そうよ、協力してあげてもいいって言ってるのっ！
contexts.english: "Yeah, I'm saying that I'll work together with you!

findings.description: The hammer-blow shock becomes a moment of understanding. That changes Shirou's reaction, but these pages do not establish a lost joke mechanism.
findings.sourceReading: Rin's offer hits Shirou like a hammer blow; he then recognizes his extraordinary good fortune.
findings.explanation: The hammer-blow shock becomes a moment of understanding. That changes Shirou's reaction, but these pages do not establish a lost joke mechanism.

contexts.japanese: ガン、とあたまをハンマーで叩かれた感じ。
contexts.english: Finally, a light bulb goes off in my head.

contexts.japanese: 突然の申し出は、これ以上ない程の幸運だった。
contexts.english: This sudden proposal is the best that could happen to me right now.

findings.description: The women deciding argument cannot settle becomes Shirou thinking so.
findings.sourceReading: Seeing their verbal fight won't produce a decision, both women hand final choice to him.
findings.explanation: The women deciding argument cannot settle becomes Shirou thinking so.

contexts.japanese: 言い合いでは決着がつかないと見たのか、二人は最後の選択をこっちに振ってきた。
contexts.english: Just when I thought the argument was going nowhere, they both decide to turn the last choice over to me.

findings.description: Shirou still protests Rin's silence, but the English drops his reminder that she asked for his answer in the first place.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou complains that Rin has prompted his response and then fallen silent when he gives it.
findings.explanation: Shirou still protests Rin's silence, but the English drops his reminder that she asked for his answer in the first place.

contexts.japanese: 「遠坂？　おい、人に話ふっといて無視するな」
contexts.english: "Tohsaka? Hey, don't ignore me when I'm talking to you."

findings.description: Rin's sarcasm about Shirou's attentiveness becomes a direct accusation that he is childish.
findings.sourceReading: Rin sarcastically remarks on the trouble Shirou takes to please Illya.
findings.explanation: Rin's sarcasm about Shirou's attentiveness becomes a direct accusation that he is childish.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふん。お子様のご機嫌とりをするなんて、随分とマメなのね衛宮くんは。なに、もしかして小さい子が好きとか、そういう趣味？」
contexts.english: "...Hmph. You like making children happy, huh? You're pretty childish yourself, Emiya. Don't tell me you're into little girls?"

findings.description: A look like one used to blame the socially vulnerable becomes a look reserved for society's dregs.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou feels Rin's gaze resembles one condemning a socially disadvantaged or weak person.
findings.explanation: A look like one used to blame the socially vulnerable becomes a look reserved for society's dregs.

contexts.japanese: その目がこう、いかにも社会的弱者を責めるようで胃が痛い。
contexts.english: She's giving me a wince-inducing look reserved for the utter dregs of society.

findings.description: Illya's second emphatic embrace disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Illya clings to Shirou with the biggest possible smile after promising to protect him from Rin.
findings.explanation: Illya's second emphatic embrace disappears.

contexts.japanese: にぱっ、とこれ以上ない笑顔で抱きついてくるイリヤ。
contexts.english: Illya beams.

findings.description: Shirou's criticism of his tangled reasoning becomes a joke about protesting too much. It makes the denial sound suspicious without establishing that Rin's insinuation is true.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou recognizes that his explanation has lurched from instinctive choice to a claim about being Illya's guardian.
findings.explanation: Shirou's criticism of his tangled reasoning becomes a joke about protesting too much. It makes the denial sound suspicious without establishing that Rin's insinuation is true.

contexts.japanese: あう、我ながらメチャクチャな論理展開。
contexts.english: Aargh. The man doth protest too much, methinks.

findings.description: Rin accusing Shirou of brazenly doubling down becomes saying his fighting spirit returned.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says he has opened up/brazened it out and stopped trying to excuse the position.
findings.explanation: Rin accusing Shirou of brazenly doubling down becomes saying his fighting spirit returned.

contexts.japanese: 「…………開き直ったわね。まあ、そこまで言うなら認めてあげてもいいけど、桜も大変ね」
contexts.english: "...Looks like you've got your fighting spirit back. If you're going to insist on it that hard, I'll respect your choice, but I feel bad for Sakura."

findings.description: A limit to Shirou's own thinking becomes being out of ideas at this point.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says what he can devise alone is limited and Rin's ideas would make the plan surer.
findings.explanation: A limit to Shirou's own thinking becomes being out of ideas at this point.

contexts.japanese: 俺の考えじゃ限界があるし、遠坂が知恵を出してくれるならその方が確実だ」
contexts.english: I'm out of ideas at this point, so any knowledge you can spare would give me a surer idea of what to do."

findings.description: Making room or yielding a place in the house becomes surrendering the entire home.
findings.sourceReading: Rin jokes that until the debt is repaid Shirou must obey, including giving up space for her and providing three meals.
findings.explanation: Making room or yielding a place in the house becomes surrendering the entire home.

contexts.japanese: その借りを返すまで、士郎はわたしの言うコトを聞くしかないの。居場所を明け渡せって言えば明け渡してくれるし、ちゃんと三食付きにしてって言ったらしてくれるのよねぇ？」
contexts.english: Until Shirou repays that debt, he has to do what I say. If I order him to surrender his home or cook me three meals a day, he'll gladly comply, won't he?"

findings.description: A guest room Rin noticed inside the detached annex on a prior visit becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way here.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks to be shown to the guest room in the detached annex, which she had marked out when previously admitted into the house.
findings.explanation: A guest room Rin noticed inside the detached annex on a prior visit becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way here.

contexts.japanese: ほら士郎、客間に案内して。前に上がった時、離れの客間に目をつけてたんだから。あ、イリヤはどこがいい？」
contexts.english: Come on, Shirou, take me to a guestroom. I saw a separate guesthouse on the way here. Oh, where do you want to sleep, Illya?"

findings.description: The detached-annex guest room Rin noticed on an earlier visit again becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way there.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks for the guest room in the detached annex that she marked out when previously admitted into the house.
findings.explanation: The detached-annex guest room Rin noticed on an earlier visit again becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way there.

contexts.japanese: 「決まりね。それじゃあがらせてもらうわよ。ほら士郎、客間に案内して。前に上がった時、離れの客間に目をつけてたんだから。あ、イリヤはどこがいい？」
contexts.english: "That settles it then. I'm coming in. Come on, Shirou, take me to a guestroom. I saw a separate guesthouse on the way here. Oh, where do you want to sleep, Illya?"

contexts.japanese: 「？　いや、桜の部屋は離れの客間だけど」
contexts.english: "Huh? Sakura's room is in the separate guesthouse."

findings.description: Rider carrying the group becomes carrying Shirou alone.
findings.sourceReading: Rider confirms that she transported Shirou and the others from the forest to the church under Sakura's order.
findings.explanation: Rider carrying the group becomes carrying Shirou alone.

contexts.japanese: 「……そうですね。貴方たちを運んだのは私です。サクラは貴方を守れと言った。私はサーヴァントとして、彼女の命に従ったまでです」
contexts.english: "...Yes. I carried you there. Sakura told me to protect you. I merely obeyed her order, as her Servant."

findings.description: Having no reason to be glared at becomes never remembering Rin glaring like this before.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou cannot think of anything he did to deserve Rin's current glare, but is relieved she is safe.
findings.explanation: Having no reason to be glared at becomes never remembering Rin glaring like this before.

contexts.japanese: ……あんなふうに睨まれる覚えはないが、とりあえず遠坂も無事だったと判ってホッとする。
contexts.english: ...I don't remember her ever glaring at me like this before, but I'm relieved that she's safe.

findings.description: Remaining Masters uniformly lacking Servants and the outcome being decided becomes victory being close because few Servants remain.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says the surviving Masters are gathered without Servants, so the result is effectively settled.
findings.explanation: Remaining Masters uniformly lacking Servants and the outcome being decided becomes victory being close because few Servants remain.

contexts.japanese: 残されたマスターがこうもそろってサーヴァントがいない状態では、もはや勝敗はついただろう」
contexts.english: Victory is close, with so few Servants remaining, despite this assembly of Masters."

findings.description: The second route to saving Sakura loses the requirement that someone obtain the Grail.
findings.sourceReading: Either Sakura must obtain the Grail, or a person who intends to save her must obtain it.
findings.explanation: The second route to saving Sakura loses the requirement that someone obtain the Grail.

contexts.japanese: 桜を救いたいのなら、それは桜が聖杯を手に入れるか、それとも—桜を助ける気がある人間が聖杯を手に入れるしかない。
contexts.english: If we want to save Sakura, then either Sakura has to win the Holy Grail, or someone willing to help her.

findings.description: Rin's reminder that Illya once nearly killed Shirou disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Rin provocatively says Illya is returning to her castle without gratitude after being saved by Shirou, whom she once nearly killed.
findings.explanation: Rin's reminder that Illya once nearly killed Shirou disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「あーら、やっぱりそうなんだ。一度殺しかけた士郎に助けられたクセに、恩も感じずにお城に戻るワケね。
contexts.english: "Oh wow, really? Shirou saved your life, but you're just gonna run back to the castle without an ounce of gratitude.

findings.description: Shirou being unreliable becomes Illya not wanting to rely on him.
findings.sourceReading: Rin falsely paraphrases Illya as refusing the house because Emiya himself is not dependable, preferring her secure castle.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unreliable becomes Illya not wanting to rely on him.

contexts.japanese: 「言ってるじゃない。衛宮くんの家に行かないのは、衛宮くんが頼りにならないからでしょ？　だから安心できる自分の城に戻るって言ってるんじゃない」
contexts.english: "You're saying it right now. You don't want to go to Emiya's house because you don't want to rely on him, right? You'd feel better back at your own castle."

findings.description: The English preserves the ruby's name but loses the treasure chest and Illya's expectation that it will be beautiful. 'Sounds pretty nice' need not mean she likes the sound of the name.
findings.sourceReading: Illya expresses interest in the apparent beauty of a treasure chest used by a magician, with a proper name supplied through ruby.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the ruby's name but loses the treasure chest and Illya's expectation that it will be beautiful. 'Sounds pretty nice' need not mean she likes the sound of the name.

contexts.japanese: 「じゃ、わたしも行くね。遠坂の師の遺産になんて興味はないけど、魔法使いの使ってた宝箱はキレイそうだし」
contexts.english: "Then I should come, too. I'm not interested in Kischur's relics, but Zel Schweinorg sounds pretty nice."

findings.description: Illya following after Rin becomes leaving Rin.
findings.sourceReading: After the terse greeting, Illya walks to the living room behind/following Tohsaka.
findings.explanation: Illya following after Rin becomes leaving Rin.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは遠坂の後に付いて居間へ歩いていく。
contexts.english: Illya leaves Tohsaka and walks to the living room.

findings.description: Sakura silently continuing to eat after the shock becomes merely eating too.
findings.sourceReading: Crushed by Rin's superior cooking, Sakura says no more and wordlessly devotes herself to moving food into her mouth.
findings.explanation: Sakura silently continuing to eat after the shock becomes merely eating too.

contexts.japanese: ショックで打ちひしがれた桜は、それきりモクモクと料理を口に運ぶだけになった。
contexts.english: Sakura was stunned, but she still ended up eating the food too.

findings.description: Sakura's promise to strike back at Rin with Shirou-taught cooking becomes a promise to make his favorites. Her grin and the following mock battle talk remain, but their setup is missing.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura proposes playful retaliation against Rin through a breakfast made using what Shirou taught her. Her mischievous grin and their subsequent talk of striking back confirm the competitive framing.
findings.explanation: Sakura's promise to strike back at Rin with Shirou-taught cooking becomes a promise to make his favorites. Her grin and the following mock battle talk remain, but their setup is missing.

contexts.japanese: 今夜は遠坂先輩にご馳走してもらいましたから、明日の朝はわたしが受け持ちますね。先輩仕込みの朝食で仕返ししてあげちゃいます」
contexts.english: Since Tohsaka-senpai took care of us tonight, I'll make breakfast tomorrow morning. I'll cook the things you like for breakfast."

findings.description: Inviting Rin inside because of a small connection becomes her stopping by the other day.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou's cover story says a minor connection led him to have Rin come into the house.
findings.explanation: Inviting Rin inside because of a small connection becomes her stopping by the other day.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ。ちょっとした縁で家にあがってもらったんだ。
contexts.english: "Yeah. She stopped by the other day.

findings.description: Shirou's admired model-student image becomes romantic fantasy and school-idol fixation.
findings.sourceReading: He jokes that the proud model student of their school died last night—in his own mind—and that 'model student Rin Tohsaka' has vanished from him.
findings.explanation: Shirou's admired model-student image becomes romantic fantasy and school-idol fixation.

contexts.japanese: 我が校の誇る優等生は昨夜死んだ。
contexts.english: Whatever fantasies I had of Tohsaka died last night.

contexts.japanese: まことに遺憾だが、優等生遠坂凛は俺の中から消え去ってしまったのだこんちくしょう。
contexts.english: To my deep regret, Rin Tohsaka, the star student and idol of my high school life, was wiped away yesterday. Damn it.

findings.description: Sakura's claim that Shirou and Rin are unrelated becomes Rin being unrelated to both Sakura and Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura insists that Senpai and that person have nothing to do with each other, while she is the one who is here, repeating why in distress.
findings.explanation: Sakura's claim that Shirou and Rin are unrelated becomes Rin being unrelated to both Sakura and Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「どうして、遠坂先輩がここに来るんですか。そんなのおかしいです。だってぜんぜん関係ない。ここにいるのはわたしで、先輩とあの人はぜんぜん関係ないのに、どうして」
contexts.english: "Why was she here? It's a little strange. She has nothing to do with us. Not me, or you, so why?"

findings.description: Rin's plan to deter gambling with death becomes a plan to keep Shirou from doing much at all.
findings.sourceReading: Rin hoped that knowing defeat directly meant death would keep Shirou from readily taking such gambles.
findings.explanation: Rin's plan to deter gambling with death becomes a plan to keep Shirou from doing much at all.

contexts.japanese: 「そうよ。負ける事がそのまま死に繋がるって知れば、そう簡単に博打は打たなくなる。衛宮くん、こういう状況でも一人で夜出歩きそうだから。
contexts.english: "Yeah. I figured you wouldn't take risks or really do much if you knew defeat meant death. But it looks like you're the kind of person to go out at night even in a situation like this.

findings.description: The account reaching the present becomes something unconscious Shirou remembers.
findings.sourceReading: Rin carried the still-unconscious Shirou home, and that sequence brings the account to the present.
findings.explanation: The account reaching the present becomes something unconscious Shirou remembers.

contexts.japanese: 傷は治ったものの意識が戻らない俺をここまで運んで、あとは今に至るという訳だとか。
contexts.english: I was still unconscious, so Tohsaka brought me here and the rest was as I remember it.

findings.description: Shirou's self-repair becomes Rin asking what she could have done.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says she can no longer perform the feat of reviving someone near death; Shirou himself somehow dealt with his scattered insides.
findings.explanation: Shirou's self-repair becomes Rin asking what she could have done.

contexts.japanese: 「まさか。死にかけてる人間を蘇生させる、なんて芸当は、もうわたしには出来ない。衛宮士郎は自分でぶっ飛んだ中身をどうにかしたのよ」
contexts.english: "No way. I can't revive someone on the verge of death. What was I supposed to do about your intestines scattered on the pavement?"

findings.description: A categorical declaration obliging Shirou to hear Rin out becomes a promise to listen.

counterexamples.description: Site inference follows briefing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says one site matches Illya’s account and seeks confirmation.
counterexamples.explanation: Site inference follows briefing.

contexts.japanese: 「それなら問題ないわ。イリヤの言う事が正しいなら、大聖杯とやらの場所は一つしかない。そうでしょイリヤ？」
contexts.english: "No problem here. Based on what Illya said, the Greater Grail can only be in one place. Isn't that right?"

counterexamples.description: Shirou intends survival despite agreeing to fight.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He means to finish the war with Sakura alive; Rin probably intends killing.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou intends survival despite agreeing to fight.

contexts.japanese: だが俺は、桜を生かす方法で戦いを終わらせて—
contexts.english: But I'm going to find a way to end this war and let her live—

counterexamples.description: Sakura says flee and Rin says fight retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Two characters advocate opposing immediate responses.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura says flee and Rin says fight retained.

contexts.japanese: 逃げろという桜と、戦うといった遠坂。
contexts.english: Sakura told us to run. Tohsaka said that she'd fight.

counterexamples.description: Need for Rider acknowledged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou says he and Rin cannot rescue Sakura alone and asks help.
counterexamples.explanation: Need for Rider acknowledged.

contexts.japanese: 「その為に—アンタの力を貸してくれ。俺と遠坂だけじゃ桜を助けられない。桜を本当に大切に思ってくれるなら、今だけでも手を貸してくれ」
contexts.english: "But to do that...I need your help. Tohsaka and I can't save her alone. If you really care about Sakura, then please help me, just this once."

counterexamples.description: Greater Grail lower destination retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Underlying source of war requires going below, rather than upper temple.
counterexamples.explanation: Greater Grail lower destination retained.

contexts.japanese: ……聖杯戦争の大聖杯に行こうっていうんなら、上じゃなくて下に行かないとね」
contexts.english: ...If you want to go to the source of the Holy Grail War, you need to go down to find the Greater Grail."

counterexamples.description: Night-search complaint and reversal retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He complains about visibility despite stars, then realizes he can see.
counterexamples.explanation: Night-search complaint and reversal retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……無茶言うなあ。星が出てるからって、夜の森で周りが見通せるかって—」
contexts.english: "...Don't be ridiculous. You think I can see in the forest at night just because the stars are out?"

counterexamples.description: Rin directs touch-through test.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She identifies right site and tells him to touch back rock to pass through.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin directs touch-through test.

contexts.japanese: 「—いいえ、ここで当たりよ士郎。奥の岩に触ってみなさい。簡単にすり抜けるから」
contexts.english: "No, this is the right place. Try touching the rock furthest in the back. You'll be able to slip through easily."

counterexamples.description: Bounded Field identification remains tentative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin calls it a kind of bounded field and goes ahead.
counterexamples.explanation: Bounded Field identification remains tentative.

contexts.japanese: 「結界の一種でしょうね。—先、行くわよ」
contexts.english: "A Bounded Field, probably. Let's keep going."

counterexamples.description: Rin’s declared intention to kill Sakura remains explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She explains why entrusting her a weapon is troubling.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin’s declared intention to kill Sakura remains explicit.

contexts.japanese: 「—だから。わたしは桜を殺すって言ってるのよ。
contexts.english: "Because. I said I was going to kill Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Shirou still needs Rin despite conflict.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He dislikes the weapon-risk situation but cannot rescue Sakura without her.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou still needs Rin despite conflict.

contexts.japanese: 「よくない。よくないけど、遠坂がいないと桜は助けられない。桜を助けたいんなら、一人より二人の方が確実だろ。
contexts.english: "I'm not okay with it. But I can't save Sakura without you, and we have a better chance together than alone.

counterexamples.description: Unfulfillable war-victor promise remains identified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He promised Rin victory in Holy Grail War.
counterexamples.explanation: Unfulfillable war-victor promise remains identified.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯戦争の勝者を遠坂にすると約束した。
contexts.english: I promised to make Tohsaka the victor of the Holy Grail War.

counterexamples.description: Retrospective affection retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She is the girl he liked then, who believed in him when he had nothing.
counterexamples.explanation: Retrospective affection retained.

contexts.japanese: 何も無かった俺を信じてくれた、遠坂凛っていう、好きだった女の子の為に。
contexts.english: For Rin Tohsaka, the girl I liked at the time, who believed in me when I had nothing left.

counterexamples.description: Secret weapon preservation retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He knows ways to counter Saber and wants jeweled sword hidden from remaining enemies.
counterexamples.explanation: Secret weapon preservation retained.

contexts.japanese: 手の内が判っているセイバーなら、こっちにも対抗策がある。まだ臓硯とアサシンが控えている状況で、唯一“秘密”である宝石剣を使うのは—
contexts.english: I know Saber, so there are ways to deal with her. We shouldn't reveal our only secret weapon while Zouken and Assassin could still be waiting—

counterexamples.description: Rin exception tied to Sakura’s orders.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Killing Rin here would violate the Master’s command.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin exception tied to Sakura’s orders.

contexts.japanese: 「凛。私には貴方と争う理由はない。くれぐれも間違いで私に剣を向けないように。—貴方をここで殺してしまっては、桜の命令に背いてしまう」
contexts.english: "Rin. I have no reason to fight you. Take care not to point that sword at me. I would be violating Sakura's orders if I killed you here now."

counterexamples.description: Former quiet Saber voice retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration explicitly connects this voice to her former one.
counterexamples.explanation: Former quiet Saber voice retained.

contexts.japanese: セイバーは静かな、以前と同じ声で、戦おうとする遠坂を諌める。
contexts.english: Saber's quiet voice is the same as ever. It stops Rin in her tracks.

counterexamples.description: Sakura wants Rin through retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin is an explicit exception because Sakura seeks the meeting.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura wants Rin through retained.

contexts.japanese: 「わたしは例外。桜の方から会いたがってるってワケ？」
contexts.english: "I'm an exception. She wants to see me?"

counterexamples.description: Rin states trust despite unknown outcome.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She does not know what will happen but trusts him to meet expectations.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin states trust despite unknown outcome.

contexts.japanese: 「士郎。アンタがどうなるかは知らないけど、わたしは信頼してるんだから。ちゃんと期待に応えてよね」
contexts.english: "Shirou. I don't know what will happen to you, but I trust you. Make sure you live up to that."

counterexamples.description: Rin rescue assurance stays Saber’s claim.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber says without her Rin will save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin rescue assurance stays Saber’s claim.

contexts.japanese: 「そういう事です。私さえいなければ、彼女は必ず桜を救う」
contexts.english: "Exactly. She will assuredly save Sakura if I am not there."

counterexamples.description: Shirou’s immediate job is preventing reunion.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He must keep Saber from returning and overwhelming Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou’s immediate job is preventing reunion.

contexts.japanese: だから、ここで俺がするべき事は、絶対にセイバーを桜の下に行かさない事。
contexts.english: Which means that what I need to do now is make absolutely sure that Saber can't rejoin Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Self-sacrifice can have purpose retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He realizes dying here need not be meaningless if it opens Rin’s route.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-sacrifice can have purpose retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……なんだ。ここで死んだら何にもならない、なんて事はなかったんだな」
contexts.english: "...Oh. I guess I'm not dying for nothing after all."

counterexamples.description: Seven-minute question to distant Rin retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber asks whether Rin can free Sakura in remaining interval.
counterexamples.explanation: Seven-minute question to distant Rin retained.

contexts.japanese: 「—あと七分。それまでに桜を解放できますか、凛」
contexts.english: "...Seven more minutes. Can you free Sakura in that time, Rin?"

counterexamples.description: No tears and limited pity retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She sheds no tears and may hold only slight pity while waiting.
counterexamples.explanation: No tears and limited pity retained.

contexts.japanese: 涙など流れない。
contexts.english: No tears flow.

contexts.japanese: 胸に擁くものがあるとすれば、それは小さな哀れみだけ。
contexts.english: The only emotion she might still have now is a hint of pity.

counterexamples.description: Grail-location confidence is limited.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest reasons about location and indicates Rin should know.
counterexamples.explanation: Grail-location confidence is limited.

contexts.japanese: 「言峰、その場所を知っているのか」
contexts.english: "Kotomine. Do you know where it is?"

contexts.japanese: 「予測はつく。正確な入り口を知りたければ凛に訊け。
contexts.english: "I can make an educated guess. Ask Rin if you want to know where the exact entrance is.

contexts.japanese: 二百年前、アインツベルンが遠坂と手を結んだのは儀式の場所を確保する為。後継者である凛ならば教えられている筈だ」
contexts.english: Two hundred years ago, the Tohsakas joined with the Einzberns to secure a location for the ritual. Rin is their successor, so she should have been told."

counterexamples.description: Disparity deters enemies in Zouken's view.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks the surviving boy and Tohsaka girl dare not challenge after seeing the power gap.
counterexamples.explanation: Disparity deters enemies in Zouken's view.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮の小倅と遠坂の小娘が生きておるのは意外じゃったが、どうという事もなかろう。あれほどの力の差を見せられ、歯向かうような馬鹿者はおらぬ」
contexts.english: I was surprised that the Emiya boy and the Tohsaka girl still live, but they can do nothing. No one would be foolish enough to challenge us after being shown the overwhelming disparity in power."

counterexamples.description: Danger to both and house explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow could crush them with the house if it wished.
counterexamples.explanation: Danger to both and house explicit.

contexts.japanese: ソレがその気になるだけで、俺たちは屋敷ごと潰される。
contexts.english: If it wanted to, it could crush us along with the entire house.

counterexamples.description: No will and no ability to sever retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura denies both intention and capacity to leave entity.
counterexamples.explanation: No will and no ability to sever retained.

contexts.japanese: 「ありません。弱いわたしはもう消えたと言ったでしょう？　折角手に入れた力だもの。わたしはアレから離れる気はないし、できない。
contexts.english: "No. I said the weak me is gone now, remember? I suffered so much for this power. I don't want to leave it, nor can I.

counterexamples.description: Possible last night of self retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She might endure only tonight and requests immediate flight.
counterexamples.explanation: Possible last night of self retained.

contexts.japanese: なら、今すぐ先輩を連れて逃げてください。わたしはそう長くはありません。このままだといつ自分が消えてしまうか判らない。わたしが耐えられるのは今夜だけかもしれない」
contexts.english: You need to take Senpai and run. I don't have much time left. I don't know when I might disappear. Tonight might be the last night I stay myself."

counterexamples.description: Mutual destruction proposed conditionally.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She asks Rin to take Shirou far away so she can take entity down with herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Mutual destruction proposed conditionally.

contexts.japanese: ……姉さん。先輩を連れて、遠いところに逃げてください。そうしてくれたら、わたしは安心してあの子と刺し違えるコトが出来ますから」
contexts.english: ...Nee-san, take Senpai and run somewhere far away. If you can do that, then I feel safe taking the child down with me."

counterexamples.description: Shoulder tremor meaning unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narrator asks whether she believes Sakura or something else.
counterexamples.explanation: Shoulder tremor meaning unresolved.

contexts.japanese: それは桜の言葉を信じてのものか、それとも。
contexts.english: Does she believe Sakura, or...

counterexamples.description: Rin attributes inconsistent desire to Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She accuses Sakura of wanting Rin dead while asking her to flee.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin attributes inconsistent desire to Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 気付いてるの桜？　貴方、さっきから言動がメチャクチャよ。わたしを殺したいクセに逃げろだなんてね。
contexts.english: Have you noticed how you don't make any sense, Sakura? You're telling me to run, even though you want to kill me.

counterexamples.description: Rin claims personal killing role.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She insists it will be her own hand, nobody else's.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin claims personal killing role.

contexts.japanese: いい桜。貴方は他の誰でもない、このわたしの手で殺してあげる」
contexts.english: Listen, Sakura. I'll be the one to kill you, and no one else."

counterexamples.description: Kindness within lethal declaration retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin speaks with kindness or gentleness despite promising to kill her.
counterexamples.explanation: Kindness within lethal declaration retained.

contexts.japanese: 優しささえ篭った声で、遠坂は断言した。
contexts.english: Tohsaka declares in a gentle voice.

counterexamples.description: Weapon's lethal purpose creates contradiction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says helping her means preparing the sword she intends to use to kill Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Weapon's lethal purpose creates contradiction.

contexts.japanese: わたしと行くって事は桜を殺すっていう事よ。宝石剣だってそう。貴方は桜を殺す武器を、わたしの為に用意しなくちゃいけないのよ」
contexts.english: Going with me means killing Sakura. That goes for the Jeweled Sword, too. You need to provide me with a weapon to kill her."

counterexamples.description: Sword still needs Projection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Prior promise and inability to resist Shadow make the future projected sword necessary despite contradiction.
counterexamples.explanation: Sword still needs Projection.

contexts.japanese: 「……そうだな。宝石の剣に関しては、確かに矛盾してる。けど今の桜は俺たちの手に負えないし、剣を作るのは以前からの約束だ。宝石の剣を投影する事で桜の影に対抗できるなら、それは絶対に必要なものだ」
contexts.english: "...Yeah. I'm definitely contradicting myself by making the Jeweled Sword. But we can't beat Sakura right now, and I already promised that I'd make it. If you need me to Project the Jeweled Sword to fight Sakura's Shadow, then it has to be done."

counterexamples.description: Total casualties not inevitable.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy says the claimed tradeoff is not settled and expects a way to save Sakura without further deaths.
counterexamples.explanation: Total casualties not inevitable.

contexts.japanese: 「まだそうと決まった訳じゃないだろう。桜を助けて、これ以上犠牲が出ない方法がある筈だ」
contexts.english: "That isn't set in stone yet. There should be a way to help Sakura without causing any more deaths."

counterexamples.description: Inescapable guilt acknowledged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration recognizes Rin's charge concerning people already killed as unavoidable guilt.
counterexamples.explanation: Inescapable guilt acknowledged.

contexts.japanese: 言い逃れのできない罪。
contexts.english: It's an inescapable sin.

counterexamples.description: Concession is conversational defeat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin admits losing the argument to his unembarrassed determination.
counterexamples.explanation: Concession is conversational defeat.

contexts.japanese: 「……そ。ま、なに言っても無駄だとは思ってたけど、まさかこれほどとはね。正直、負けたわ」
contexts.english: "...Okay. I didn't think you'd listen to me, but you're this stubborn? Honestly, I give up."

counterexamples.description: Pouting register shift retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Former tension gives way to her slightly puffed cheeks.
counterexamples.explanation: Pouting register shift retained.

contexts.japanese: さっきまでの緊張は何処にいったのか、遠坂は微妙に頬をプリプリさせている。
contexts.english: Where did all her tension go? Tohsaka seems to be pouting, strangely enough.

counterexamples.description: Rin's restraint is precisely conditional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She leaves Sakura to him while he tries and steps in only once he cannot move.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's restraint is precisely conditional.

contexts.japanese: 士郎が頑張っているかぎり、桜をどうするかは貴方に任せる。わたしの出番は貴方が動けなくなってからにしてあげるわ。
contexts.english: As long as you keep trying, I'll let you decide how to deal with Sakura. I won't step in until you can't move anymore.

counterexamples.description: Saving her remains possible not guaranteed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His efforts might save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Saving her remains possible not guaranteed.

contexts.japanese: ……それなら文句ないでしょ。士郎の頑張り次第で桜は助かるかもしれないんだから」
contexts.english: ...No complaints there, right? You might be able to save her if you work hard enough."

counterexamples.description: Opposition remains despite shared care.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Their thinking still points in opposite directions even as boy believes Rin wants to save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Opposition remains despite shared care.

contexts.japanese: 俺たちの考えは正反対だ。
contexts.english: We're thinking in opposite directions.

counterexamples.description: Shared affection in intact entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou and Rin both like or love Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Shared affection in intact entry.

contexts.japanese: 俺と遠坂、どっちも桜が好きだっていうんなら。
contexts.english: We both love Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Ten PM before preparation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Current time explicitly ten at night.
counterexamples.explanation: Ten PM before preparation.

contexts.japanese: 時刻は夜の十時。
contexts.english: It's 10:00 PM.

counterexamples.description: Prior shroud use concealed from Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya has not told Rin he already released the shroud.
counterexamples.explanation: Prior shroud use concealed from Rin.

contexts.japanese: イリヤ、遠坂には聖骸布を解いた事を言っていないんだ。
contexts.english: Illya hasn't told Tohsaka that I took off the holy shroud.

counterexamples.description: Approximate half-power hope, no exact duplicate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If all goes well original cannot be exactly copied but roughly half ability expected.
counterexamples.explanation: Approximate half-power hope, no exact duplicate.

contexts.japanese: 出来るだけ宝石剣に似せたアゾット剣と、士郎の投影とイリヤのサポート。うまくいけばオリジナルの複製とはいかないけど、半分ぐらいは能力の再現ができる筈よ」
contexts.english: I did my best to find you an Azoth Blade similar to the Jeweled Sword, and Illya will be supporting your Projection. If this goes well, we won't be able to replicate the original, but we should get something with about half of its power."

counterexamples.description: Boy recognizes huge stored mana.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even an incomplete mage can perceive strongly charged weapon.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy recognizes huge stored mana.

contexts.japanese: そればかりではなく、半人前の俺でさえ判るほど強大な魔力が蓄積されていた。
contexts.english: But not just that—even I can tell that it's charged with a massive amount of magical energy.

counterexamples.description: Relative mana scales retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Small handful against Sakura yet hundreds times boy's capacity.
counterexamples.explanation: Relative mana scales retained.

contexts.japanese: ……まあ、桜の纏った影に比べたら掌一つ分の魔力ではあるのだが、それでも俺の許容量からすれば何百倍という破格さだ。
contexts.english: ...It might just be a small handful compared to the Shadow cloaking Sakura, but it's hundreds of times my own capacity.

counterexamples.description: All jewels and decade reserves spent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin commits all remaining jewels and ten years' mana.
counterexamples.explanation: All jewels and decade reserves spent.

contexts.japanese: 「凄いのは当たり前。なにしろ残った宝石を全部つぎ込んだ、わたしの十年分の魔力なんだから」
contexts.english: "Of course it's amazing. I transferred all the jewels I have left into it, so it has ten years' worth of my magical energy."

counterexamples.description: Movement possible while ordinary magic unavailable.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She can manage physical activity but has not recovered enough mana for magecraft.
counterexamples.explanation: Movement possible while ordinary magic unavailable.

contexts.japanese: 「そうね、飛んだり跳ねたりぐらいはなんとか。けど魔術を使えるほど魔力は回復してないわ」
contexts.english: "I can still jump and run around, so I'll manage. I still haven't recovered enough power to use magecraft, though."

counterexamples.description: Private Projection request retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants only Illya with him and asks Rin to wait.
counterexamples.explanation: Private Projection request retained.

contexts.japanese: それと、投影中はイリヤと二人きりになりたいんで、遠坂は部屋で待っててくれ」
contexts.english: I want to be alone with Illya while I do the Projection, so go wait in your room, Tohsaka."

counterexamples.description: Rin compromises by waiting outside.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She accepts staying beyond shed door.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin compromises by waiting outside.

contexts.japanese: 「……わかったわ、わたしは蔵の外で待機してる。それでいいんでしょ、イリヤ」
contexts.english: "...All right. I'll wait outside the shed. That's fine, right?"

counterexamples.description: Screaming example is a conditional joke.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She promises not to enter even if he screams.
counterexamples.explanation: Screaming example is a conditional joke.

contexts.japanese: 「しつこいわね。分かったって言ったでしょ、たとえ士郎の悲鳴があがっても中には入らないわよ」
contexts.english: "Persistent, aren't you? I said I get it. I won't go in even if Shirou screams."

counterexamples.description: Rin expects Azoth to disappear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She thinks Azoth is consumed once jeweled sword is made.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin expects Azoth to disappear.

contexts.japanese: 「？　貰うも何も、それを使って今から投影するんじゃない。宝石剣が出来たらアゾット剣はなくなるわよ」
contexts.english: "Huh? I mean, you're about to use it for the Projection. The Azoth Blade will be gone once you make the Jeweled Sword."

counterexamples.description: Breakage-blame pretext retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He requests ownership to remove feared blame if it breaks.
counterexamples.explanation: Breakage-blame pretext retained.

contexts.japanese: ほら、失敗したらこの剣も壊れるかもしれないし。その時、遠坂に怒られるかと思うと集中できない」
contexts.english: It might break if I fail, and I can't concentrate when I think of you getting mad at me for breaking something you own."

counterexamples.description: Likely guilt rather than certain intervention.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin probably will not stop him now but will feel responsible.
counterexamples.explanation: Likely guilt rather than certain intervention.

contexts.japanese: 事此処にいたって止めはしないだろうが、あいつは絶対に責任を感じる。
contexts.english: She probably wouldn't stop me, but she would definitely feel responsible.

counterexamples.description: Approval deliberately after war.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He intends retrospective admission/approval after war is over.
counterexamples.explanation: Approval deliberately after war.

contexts.japanese: それを和らげる為には、聖杯戦争が終わった後、実はもう使ってしまってました、と事後承諾させるしかないのだ。
contexts.english: The only way to alleviate that is to get her ex post facto approval with a "sorry, I actually used it," once the Holy Grail War is over.

counterexamples.description: Only Schweinorg lineage can wield it.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Weapon's exceptional usability restriction explains boy's impression.
counterexamples.explanation: Only Schweinorg lineage can wield it.

contexts.japanese: 「それはそれでいいのよ。その剣はシュバインオーグの系譜の者にしか扱えない、とびっきりの魔剣なんだから。
contexts.english: "It's good enough. Only the Schweinorg lineage can use that sword. It's a magical sword unlike any other.

counterexamples.description: Third/Second distinction retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura receives Third's blessing while young Rin seeks to wield Second.
counterexamples.explanation: Third/Second distinction retained.

contexts.japanese: ま、考えてみると因果よね。サクラは第三の加護を受けて、リンは若輩の身でありながら第二を駆使しようっていうんだから。協会の連中がいたら調査どころの話じゃない、各部門あげての裁判沙汰になりかねないわ」
contexts.english: I guess you could call it fate. Sakura is blessed by the Third, while Rin's going to operate the Second at a young age. If the Association knew about this, they'd do more than just investigate. It would turn into a court battle against every single department."

counterexamples.description: Blueprint inherited rather than original sword.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Tohsakas received design alone.
counterexamples.explanation: Blueprint inherited rather than original sword.

contexts.japanese: 「と言っても、遠坂に継承されたのは設計図だけで宝石剣そのものじゃないわ。
contexts.english: "Still, the Tohsakas only inherited the blueprints, not the Jeweled Sword itself.

counterexamples.description: Return of master only possible.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zelretch seems absent from this world and might visit after Rin's achievement.
counterexamples.explanation: Return of master only possible.

contexts.japanese: ゼルレッチ本人はこの世界にはいないようだけど、リンが自分の手で宝石剣を作れるようになったらひょっこりやってくるかもしれない」
contexts.english: I think Zelretch isn't in this world at the moment, but he might pop in for a visit once he hears that Rin managed to make the Jeweled Sword herself."

counterexamples.description: Comprehension failure distinguished from hearing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He hears but cannot understand her words.
counterexamples.explanation: Comprehension failure distinguished from hearing.

contexts.japanese: 聞こえないのではなく、遠坂は知らない言葉で喋っている。
contexts.english: It's not that I can't hear her, but Tohsaka's saying words I don't understand.

counterexamples.description: Hand-off inferred after memory gap.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sword he apparently projected is already with Rin while his hand is empty.
counterexamples.explanation: Hand-off inferred after memory gap.

contexts.japanese: アレはついさっき俺が投影した＜らしい＞もので、左手はとうに空っぽで、つまりもう遠坂に手渡したのか。
contexts.english: I just Projected that (I think), and my left hand is empty, which means I must've given it to her.

counterexamples.description: Pendant prompts astonishment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin sees bloody hand's pendant and is shocked.
counterexamples.explanation: Pendant prompts astonishment.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂は愕然と、俺の掌にあるペンダントを見つめている。
contexts.english: Tohsaka looks astonished. She's looking at the pendant in my hand.

counterexamples.description: Two matching pendants recognized.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin produces hers and boy sees exact match.
counterexamples.explanation: Two matching pendants recognized.

contexts.japanese: 確かに同じだ。
contexts.english: It's exactly the same.

counterexamples.description: Different remaining energy and prior use matter.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Hers empty, his has some remaining, and having been used carries significance.
counterexamples.explanation: Different remaining energy and prior use matter.

contexts.japanese: 「違うわ。わたしのは空っぽだけど、士郎のは少しだけ残ってる。取るに足りない量だけど、それでも、使われたからには意味があるんだわ」
contexts.english: "No, they're not. Mine's empty, but yours still has a little left in it. It isn't enough to use for anything, but... It has meaning because it was used."

counterexamples.description: Possible later usefulness retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She tells him to keep it because it might help.
counterexamples.explanation: Possible later usefulness retained.

contexts.japanese: 「それ、持っていて。何かの役に立つかもしれないから」
contexts.english: "Keep it. It might come in handy."

counterexamples.description: Private conversation undisclosed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin takes Illya away and she silently follows.
counterexamples.explanation: Private conversation undisclosed.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂はイリヤを連れて行き、イリヤも黙ったままついて行く。
contexts.english: She goes off with Illya, who also doesn't say a word.

counterexamples.description: Midnight agreed time preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Departure meets midnight arrangement.
counterexamples.explanation: Midnight agreed time preserved.

contexts.japanese: 午前零時、約束の時間になった。
contexts.english: It's midnight, the time we agreed on.

counterexamples.description: No sign of combat remains observed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He sees no indication of fighting.
counterexamples.explanation: No sign of combat remains observed.

contexts.japanese: 戦いの気配など何処にもない。
contexts.english: There are no signs of any fighting.

counterexamples.description: Forgotten rescue words yield unnecessary Rin question.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He forgets words to restore Sakura and asks what he already thinks he knows.
counterexamples.explanation: Forgotten rescue words yield unnecessary Rin question.

contexts.japanese: 桜を取り戻す言葉を忘れて、しなくてもいい質問、分かりきった疑問を口にする。
contexts.english: I forget what I needed to say to bring Sakura back, and ask an unnecessary question that I already know the answer to.

counterexamples.description: Ribbon-like trace remains uncertain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Observed black scrap resembles ribbon at her feet.
counterexamples.explanation: Ribbon-like trace remains uncertain.

contexts.japanese: 黒く染まった地面には、黒い、リボンのような布きれが転がっている。
contexts.english: There's something that looks like a black ribbon on the darkened ground around her feet.

counterexamples.description: Sakura directly claims she swallowed Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She states she just swallowed her.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura directly claims she swallowed Rin.

contexts.japanese: だって—さっき、わたしが呑み込んでしまったんですもの」
contexts.english: I mean, I just swallowed her up earlier."

counterexamples.description: Not dead but suffering inside retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura says Rin is not dead and suffers inside her.
counterexamples.explanation: Not dead but suffering inside retained.

contexts.japanese: 「けど姉さんは死んでなんかいません。いまもこうやって、わたしのなかで苦しんでいます。
contexts.english: "But Nee-san isn't dead. Even now, she's still suffering inside me.

counterexamples.description: Replay of abuse and first-day breakdown retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She claims to make Rin experience her past from start, breaking on first day.
counterexamples.explanation: Replay of abuse and first-day breakdown retained.

contexts.japanese: ……くす。姉さん、あんなに弱かったんですね。わたしがされたコトを一から体験させてあげてるんですけど、一日目で泣き崩れてる」
contexts.english: ...Hehe. She was so weak, you know. I'm making her experience everything that happened to me from the beginning. She broke down crying on the first day."

counterexamples.description: Pleas intensify enjoyment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin's plea makes Sakura want further enjoyment.
counterexamples.explanation: Pleas intensify enjoyment.

contexts.japanese: バカな姉さん。そんなコト言われたら、もっと愉しみたくなるのに」
contexts.english: Stupid Nee-san. Saying that makes me want to enjoy it even more."

counterexamples.description: Saving two and killing Rin is Sakura's accusation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She credits boy with saving Saber and Sakura and killing Rin for her.
counterexamples.explanation: Saving two and killing Rin is Sakura's accusation.

contexts.japanese: 「けど嬉しいです。先輩はセイバーを助けて、わたしを助けて、姉さんを殺してくれた。
contexts.english: "But I'm so happy. You saved Saber, saved me, and killed Nee-san for me.

counterexamples.description: Crest protects unconscious heir.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Inherited Tohsaka Crest will not easily let successor die even without consciousness.
counterexamples.explanation: Crest protects unconscious heir.

contexts.japanese: 刻印は遠坂家が遺してきた魔術の結晶だ。遠坂が意識を失っても、易々と後継者を死なせはしない。
contexts.english: The Crest is a crystallization of the Tohsakas' inherited magecraft. Even if she loses consciousness, it won't allow its heir to die so easily.
