contexts.english: "Why? Are you trying to get her to team up with Sakura?"

counterexamples.description: Original desire to stop fighting is recognized as persistent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin identifies his starting ideal still unchanged.
counterexamples.explanation: Original desire to stop fighting is recognized as persistent.

contexts.japanese: 「初めから戦いを止める為に、でしょ？　なんだ、それまだ変わってなかったんだ」
contexts.english: "You want to stop the war, right? So that still hasn't changed, huh?"

counterexamples.description: Bright smile and insult remain paired.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin calls him very stupid with surprising grin.
counterexamples.explanation: Bright smile and insult remain paired.

contexts.japanese: こっちがびっくりするぐらいの笑顔で、そんなコトを言いやがった。
contexts.english: She gives me a grin so bright it makes me blink, even as she says that.

contexts.japanese: 「衛宮くんって、すっごいバカでしょ」
contexts.english: "Emiya, you're really stupid."

counterexamples.description: Destination inference begins as guess, then confirmed by his clothing/words.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says earlier shot in dark; now recognizes plan talk Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Destination inference begins as guess, then confirmed by his clothing/words.

contexts.japanese: 「いいからいいから。で、その格好からするに衛宮くんもイリヤスフィールに用が有るってワケね。さっきはあてずっぽうで言ったけど、ホントにイリヤスフィールと話し合いをするつもりなんだ」
contexts.english: "All right, settle down. From the looks of it, you've got some business with Illyasviel. I was just taking a shot in the dark earlier, but you really do intend to talk to her."

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes his accidental disclosure.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Said unnecessary fact revealing destination.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes his accidental disclosure.

contexts.japanese: また口にしなくともいいコトを。
contexts.english: I said something else I shouldn't have.

counterexamples.description: Rin's map remains old and distrusted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Knows general area but doubts ancient map reliability.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's map remains old and distrusted.

contexts.japanese: わたしもだいたいの場所は判るんだけど、大昔の地図だから信憑性低くって。衛宮くんが知ってるなら話は早いわ」
contexts.english: I know her general area, but I don't really trust my old map. If you know where to go, that saves me a lot of trouble."

counterexamples.description: Rin prefers common front and names warning mission.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If possible cooperate; immediate objective Zouken, came to warn Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin prefers common front and names warning mission.

contexts.japanese: 「売らないわよ？　イリヤスフィールと共闘できるなら、それに越した事はないもの。とりあえずやるべき事は臓硯の排除でしょ。わたしがここに来たのは、イリヤスフィールに忠告に来ただけだもの」
contexts.english: "I won't, not if she's willing to form a common front. First order of things is to eliminate Zouken, right? I just came here to give her a warning."

counterexamples.description: Rin prepared for warning to trigger combat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She doubts direct dialogue and accepts possible fight after warning.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin prepared for warning to trigger combat.

contexts.japanese: けど、そう忠告したところで戦いになるって覚悟してたけどね。わたしとあの子じゃ話し合いなんて出来ない。
contexts.english: But I'm ready for it to turn into a fight once I warn her. I can't have a dialogue with that girl.

counterexamples.description: Shirou's option can remove fight risk.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If he has prospect, no need dangerous gamble; his effort may settle peacefully.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーはやられちまったけど、なんとかイリヤだけは助けられた。遠坂同様、これからうちで預かるけど仲良くしてやってくれ」
contexts.english: Her Berserker got taken out, but we managed to save her. She's going to be staying with us like Tohsaka, so try to get along."

counterexamples.description: Shirou retracts the dinner-as-storm image.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Oppressive calm better describes it.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou retracts the dinner-as-storm image.

contexts.japanese: ……ああいや、嵐と言うには語弊がある。
contexts.english: ...Okay, to call it a storm would be misleading.

counterexamples.description: The meal is dominated by tension.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Stillness does not mean comfort.
counterexamples.explanation: The meal is dominated by tension.

contexts.japanese: ともかく、恐ろしい緊張感に支配された夕食だったのだ。
contexts.english: Anyway, it was a dinner fraught with tension.

counterexamples.description: Rin cooks alone and outclasses Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura may barely match her in Western food.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin cooks alone and outclasses Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂はそう言って夕飯を一人で作り、その味は悔しいが惨敗であり、かろうじて桜が得意とする洋食なら互角かも、というものだった。
contexts.english: With that, Tohsaka starts cooking on her own, and I'm forced to admit that she's better at it than me. Sakura's Western-style cooking might barely measure up.

counterexamples.description: Excellent food is not enjoyable under anxiety.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Quality and subjective pleasure remain distinct.
counterexamples.explanation: Excellent food is not enjoyable under anxiety.

contexts.japanese: 結果、あれだけ上等だった遠坂の手料理を美味いとは感じられず、ただただ遠坂凛が攻守ともに隙なしの優等生と思い知らされた一時間だったのだ。
contexts.english: As a result, I couldn't enjoy Tohsaka's excellent cooking, and spent the hour being reminded of what a flawless overachiever Rin Tohsaka is.

counterexamples.description: Rin postpones detailed discussion until morning.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Tonight is for rest.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin postpones detailed discussion until morning.

contexts.japanese: 詳しい話は明日の朝にするから、今夜はもう休みなさい」
contexts.english: We can hash out the details tomorrow morning. Get some rest, everyone."

counterexamples.description: Shirou's lineage theory remains speculative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says maybe Illya ranks Rin and Sakura below her.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's lineage theory remains speculative.

contexts.japanese: その中で最も大きな権利を持っていたのがアインツベルンらしいから、イリヤとしちゃあ遠坂も桜も格下扱いなんだろうけど。
contexts.english: Apparently, the Einzberns had the most authority, so maybe Illya thinks of Tohsaka and Sakura as beneath her.

counterexamples.description: The one-punch line remains culinary competitive comedy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No physical assault occurs.
counterexamples.explanation: The one-punch line remains culinary competitive comedy.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ、任せてください。きっとわんぱんちして見せますから」
contexts.english: "You can count on me. I'll knock her out in one punch!"

counterexamples.description: Sakura privately asks that Rin not be told.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She uses sister and keeps her back turned.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura privately asks that Rin not be told.

contexts.japanese: 「—あの、先輩。さっきの事、姉さんには黙っていてください」
contexts.english: "...Um, Senpai. Please don't tell my sister what happened just earlier."

counterexamples.description: Private use of sister is associated with being alone with Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The pattern is framed locally.
counterexamples.explanation: Private use of sister is associated with being alone with Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 桜がそう口にするのは、決まって俺と二人きりの時だけだ。
contexts.english: Sakura never refers to Tohsaka that way except when we're alone.

counterexamples.description: Shirou hears an uncontained wish for help in the address.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This remains his interpretation.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou hears an uncontained wish for help in the address.

contexts.japanese: ……助けてほしいという心の声を殺しきれない時、桜は遠坂を“姉さん”と呼ぶ。
contexts.english: ...When she can't stop herself from wishing for help, she calls Tohsaka her big sister.

counterexamples.description: Shirou hopes reconciling the sisters may best help Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The solution remains a question, not achievement.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou hopes reconciling the sisters may best help Sakura.

contexts.japanese: それは—俺がしてやれる中で、一番桜のためになる事なんじゃないだろうか。
contexts.english: I think that might be the best thing I can do for Sakura.

counterexamples.description: He sees hope despite a rocky start.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The damaged opportunity conclusion is excluded.
counterexamples.explanation: He sees hope despite a rocky start.

contexts.japanese: 「……うん。二人ともぎくしゃくしてるけど脈はあるし」
contexts.english: "...Yeah. They're off to a rocky start, but there's still hope."

counterexamples.description: Taiga guesses Illya resents choosing Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The explanation is a question, not truth.
counterexamples.explanation: Taiga guesses Illya resents choosing Rin.

contexts.japanese: む。かつてないほどの拗ねブリ。そんなに遠坂さんを優先したコトがイヤだったの？
contexts.english: Mrgh. You've never sulked this hard before. Are you that against him picking Tohsaka over you?

counterexamples.description: Taiga says all four died.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This dojo recap extends beyond the separately witnessed branch details.
counterexamples.explanation: Taiga says all four died.

contexts.japanese: けどまあいいじゃない、遠坂さんもアーチャーさんも士郎もイリヤちゃんも、みんな仲良く死んじゃったんだから！
contexts.english: But hey, that wasn't so bad. Miss Tohsaka and Archer and Shirou and you all died happily ever after!

counterexamples.description: Shirou contrasts his amateur status with Rin's competence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Alliance is rational on skill grounds.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou contrasts his amateur status with Rin's competence.

contexts.japanese: 俺は素人で、遠坂は魔術師としてもマスターとしても一人前。
contexts.english: I'm an amateur, while Tohsaka is a first-rate mage and Master.

counterexamples.description: The previous night makes alliance the wiser choice.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou recognizes practical logic before refusing.
counterexamples.explanation: The previous night makes alliance the wiser choice.

contexts.japanese: 昨夜の事もあるし、ここは遠坂と手を組む方が賢明だろう。
contexts.english: Given what happened last night, teaming up with her is clearly the wiser choice.

counterexamples.description: Shirou credits Rin and Saber with survival and fears Berserker's next attack.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The danger is prospective.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou credits Rin and Saber with survival and fears Berserker's next attack.

contexts.japanese: それでも生きているのは遠坂とセイバーのおかげであり、バーサーカーに狙われているかぎり、次こそは跡形もなく殺される。
contexts.english: I'm only alive thanks to Tohsaka and Saber. As long as Berserker is after me, I'm as sure as dead the next time we meet.

counterexamples.description: Shirou asks whether alliance entails fighting Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is the specific obstacle.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou asks whether alliance entails fighting Illya.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂と手を組むって事は、あの子と戦うって事だよな」
contexts.english: If I team up with you, that means we'll fight her."

counterexamples.description: Rin conditions lethal response on Illya's own intent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: General Master rivalry and actual kill intent remain distinguishable.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin conditions lethal response on Illya's own intent.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。あっちがその気なんだから応えるまでよ。
contexts.english: "Yeah. If she comes after us, then we'll respond in kind.

counterexamples.description: Rin states all Masters are opponents and will answer lethal intent in kind.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The policy is attributed to her.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin states all Masters are opponents and will answer lethal intent in kind.

contexts.japanese: どの道マスターは全員倒すべき相手だもの。イリヤスフィールがその気なら、こっちだって殺す気でやる」
contexts.english: We have to defeat all the other Masters, sooner or later. If that's how Illyasviel wants to play, then we'll shoot to kill as well."

counterexamples.description: Rin asks whether Illya's appearance deceives him.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The accusation remains a question.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin asks whether Illya's appearance deceives him.

contexts.japanese: 「衛宮くん？　まさかとは思うけど、イリヤスフィールの外見に騙されてるんじゃないでしょうね」
contexts.english: "Emiya? I hope you aren't fooled by Illyasviel's appearance."

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes Rin's insight as sharp.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He partly accepts her diagnosis.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes Rin's insight as sharp.

contexts.japanese: 実に鋭い。
contexts.english: She sure is sharp.

counterexamples.description: Shirou refuses because the policy is too grave for a quick decision.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He appreciates Rin's concern.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou refuses because the policy is too grave for a quick decision.

contexts.japanese: 心配してくれるのはありがたいけど、いい返事はできない。事が事だからな。簡単に方針を決めちゃいけない気がする」
contexts.english: I appreciate your concern, but I can't give you the answer you want. As heavy as this whole thing is, I don't think I should just jump to a decision here."

counterexamples.description: Rin responds with narrowed eyes and emotionless acknowledgment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The negotiation cools.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin responds with narrowed eyes and emotionless acknowledgment.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂は少しだけ目を細めて、そう、と感情のない声で頷いた。
contexts.english: Tohsaka slightly narrows her eyes, then gives an emotionless nod.

counterexamples.description: Rin interprets serious victory as trusting no one.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is her reading of the refusal.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin interprets serious victory as trusting no one.

contexts.japanese: 「それじゃ交渉は決裂ね。……ま、確かに衛宮くんの言い分も正しいわ。本当に勝つ気があるなら誰も信用できないもの」
contexts.english: "Then I guess that's it. Though you're right about one thing. If you really want to win, you can't trust anyone."

counterexamples.description: Shirou explicitly says he trusts Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He refuses only unilateral commitment without Saber.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou explicitly says he trusts Rin.

contexts.japanese: 「そんな事ないぞ。俺、遠坂は信用してる。ただ一人で決められる事じゃないだけだ。俺がセイバーのマスターなら、あいつに無断で約束はできない」
contexts.english: "That isn't true. I trust you, Tohsaka. I just don't think I can make this decision on my own. If I'm Saber's Master, then I shouldn't make commitments without looping her in."

counterexamples.description: Rin accepts the reasoning and turns away.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The break is calm rather than an attack.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin accepts the reasoning and turns away.

contexts.japanese: 納得したように頷いて、遠坂はあっさりと背を向けた。
contexts.english: Tohsaka nods again in acceptance and quickly turns away.

counterexamples.description: Rin warns their next meeting will be as enemies.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The warning belongs to this failed negotiation state.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin warns their next meeting will be as enemies.

contexts.japanese: 「それじゃあね。次に出会ったら敵同士だから」
contexts.english: "See you around. Next time, we'll meet as enemies."

counterexamples.description: Shirou compares Saber's approach to Rin's preemptive style.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is his inference.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou compares Saber's approach to Rin's preemptive style.

contexts.japanese: セイバーも遠坂と同じで、やられる前にやるタイプなのか。
contexts.english: Saber is probably the same as Tohsaka: she's the sort to strike first.

counterexamples.description: He reconsiders refusing Rin's alliance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No alliance is retroactively formed.
counterexamples.explanation: He reconsiders refusing Rin's alliance.

contexts.japanese: こうなると、やっぱり遠坂と手を組んだ方が良かったんだろうか。
contexts.english: Maybe I should have teamed up with Tohsaka after all.

counterexamples.description: Rin's nursing remains Shirou's recollection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He remembers she cared for him after Berserker.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's nursing remains Shirou's recollection.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーとの一件のあと、倒れた俺を看病してくれたのは遠坂だ。
contexts.english: Tohsaka took care of me after I collapsed during the Berserker fight.

counterexamples.description: Shirou's account remains a cover story.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He calls the injury a foolish accident and Rin a passerby who treated him.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's account remains a cover story.

contexts.japanese: その、つまんないドジでケガしちまってさ。偶然通りがかった遠坂が親切にも手当てしてくれたんだよ。さすが我が校の誇る優等生。慈愛に満ちてるってもんだ」
contexts.english: Um, I was stupid and got myself hurt. Tohsaka was passing by and was kind enough to give me first aid. She really is the gracious star student of our school, huh."

counterexamples.description: Rin's condemnation remains imagined.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou predicts what she would say if she heard Kirei.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's condemnation remains imagined.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂が聞いたら、アンタなんか初めっから神父失格よ、なんて言うに決まってる。
contexts.english: If Tohsaka heard that, she'd say he's always been a failure.

counterexamples.description: The recap preserves the school battle as last night's starting point.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou lacked time to think after witnessing Lancer and Archer.
counterexamples.explanation: The recap preserves the school battle as last night's starting point.

contexts.japanese: 昨夜の事件—夜の学校でランサーとアーチャーの戦いを目撃してからこっち、まともに考える時間がなかった為だ。
contexts.english: Ever since last night, when I witnessed Lancer and Archer fighting at the school, I haven't had time to collect my thoughts.

counterexamples.description: Rin remains the only known opponent and unwilling target.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou does not want to fight her though she appears ready.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin remains the only known opponent and unwilling target.

contexts.japanese: 戦うと決めたものの、判っている相手は遠坂だけで、俺はあいつとドンパチやる気はまったくない。
contexts.english: I decided to fight, yet the only opponent that I know of is Tohsaka, and I have no intention of fighting her at all.

contexts.japanese: ……ああいや、向こうはやる気満々だから、そうも言ってはいられないだろうが。
contexts.english: ...Well actually, she's ready to fight me, so I guess I'm not the one in a position to say that.

counterexamples.description: Two years near Rin demonstrate Shirou's poor mage detection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He repeatedly saw her without recognizing her identity.
counterexamples.explanation: Two years near Rin demonstrate Shirou's poor mage detection.

contexts.japanese: そもそも同じ学校にいた遠坂の正体にも気づかなかったんだぞ、俺は。
contexts.english: I mean, I didn't even realize Tohsaka's identity, and we go to the same school.

contexts.japanese: 二年間も同じ建物にいて、あまつさえ何度も見かけているっていうのにだ。
contexts.english: We were in the same building for two years, and on top of that, I saw her many times.

counterexamples.description: Rin correctly connects shielding a Servant with the Master's death ending the contract.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She scolds Shirou for protecting a Servant despite the Master's survival being necessary.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin correctly connects shielding a Servant with the Master's death ending the contract.

contexts.japanese: 「マスターが死んだらサーヴァントは消えるって言ったでしょう？　だっていうのにサーヴァントを庇うなんてどうかしてるわ」
contexts.english: "If the Master dies, the Servant disappears too, remember? I can't believe you actually tried to shield your own Servant."

counterexamples.description: Rin's church intervention remains a survival measure rather than help toward victory.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She wanted an ignorant Shirou to have a chance to survive alone.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's church intervention remains a survival measure rather than help toward victory.

contexts.japanese: 「あのね衛宮くん。きっちりと言っておくけど、教会まで連れて行ったのは貴方に勝たせる為じゃないわ。
contexts.english: "I'll be straight with you, Emiya. I didn't take you to the church so that you could win.

contexts.japanese: あれはね、何も知らない貴方が一人でも生き残れるようにって考えた結果なの。どうも、そのあたりを解ってなかったみたいね」
contexts.english: I was just trying to give you a chance to survive because you literally don't know anything. It sounds like you still don't get it."

counterexamples.description: Rin explicitly admits a full night of worry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her anger follows from Shirou making her worry all night.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin explicitly admits a full night of worry.

contexts.japanese: 「関係あるわよ、このわたしを一晩も心配させたんだから！」
contexts.english: "It has everything to do with me, because you made me worry all night long!"

counterexamples.description: Shirou's thanks also carry an apology.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He bows to Rin with gratitude and apology after learning what she did.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's thanks also carry an apology.

contexts.japanese: 「そうか。遠坂には世話になったんだな。ありがとう」
contexts.english: "Is that so? Guess I owe you one, Tohsaka. Thanks."

contexts.japanese: 感謝と謝罪をこめて頭をさげる。
contexts.english: I bow my head in appreciation and apology.

counterexamples.description: Rin explicitly credits Shirou's own power with completing the healing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her help did not replace the self-repair that actually closed the wound.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin explicitly credits Shirou's own power with completing the healing.

contexts.japanese: 「ここで重要なのは、貴方は貴方一人で生ききったっていう事実よ。確かにわたしは手助けしたけど、あの傷を完治させたのは貴方自身の力だった。そこ、勘違いしないでよね」
contexts.english: "What's important here is that you managed to survive on your own. I might have helped a bit, but it was your power that healed your wound. So, don't get that twisted, okay?"

contexts.japanese: 「話を聞くとそうみたいだけど。なんだ、遠坂が治してくれたんじゃないのか？」
contexts.english: "That's what it sounds like from the way you told it. So you aren't the one who healed me?"

counterexamples.description: Rin's warning about unknown extra healing costs remains speculative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She is certain something besides Saber's mana is consumed but jokes through possible lifespan, luck and savings.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's warning about unknown extra healing costs remains speculative.

contexts.japanese: 「バカね、そんな理由じゃないわよ。断言してもいいけど、貴方の傷を治すと減るのはセイバーの魔力だけじゃない。
contexts.english: "That's not the point, dummy. Let me be clear: it costs more than Saber's magical energy to heal your wounds.

contexts.japanese: —貴方、それ絶対なんか使ってるわ。
contexts.english: You're giving something up when it happens.

contexts.japanese: 寿命とか勝負運とか預金残高とか、ともかく何かが減りまくってるに違いないんだから」
contexts.english: Whether that's your life, your luck, or even your bank account, you can bet that kind of healing doesn't come cheap."

counterexamples.description: The bank-balance tangent remains a joke about magecraft consuming money.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou questions the example and Rin turns it into a personal grievance.
counterexamples.explanation: The bank-balance tangent remains a joke about magecraft consuming money.

contexts.japanese: 「遠坂。預金残高は関係ないのでは」
contexts.english: "Tohsaka. I don't think my bank account has anything to do with it."

contexts.japanese: 「関係あるわよ！　魔術ってのは金食い虫なんだから、使ってればどんどんどんどんお金は減っていくものなの！
contexts.english: "Of course it does! Using magecraft means you're pretty much throwing your money away. The more you use it, the more it drains your money!

contexts.japanese: そうでなければ許さないんだから、とくにわたしが！」
contexts.english: Otherwise none of this would be acceptable! Especially to me!"

counterexamples.description: Shirou distinguishes Rin's private self from her school persona.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Talking with her confirms that the present Rin feels genuine and school Rin formal.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou distinguishes Rin's private self from her school persona.

contexts.japanese: 話せば話すほど、こっちの遠坂が地で、学校での遠坂がよそ行きだと判ってしまう。
contexts.english: The more I talk to her, the more this Tohsaka feels like the real one, while the girl at school feels like an act.

contexts.japanese: ……ああ、いやまあ、そんなのは昨日の段階で判りきっていた事だったか。
contexts.english: ...Though, I guess I already noticed that yesterday.

counterexamples.description: Rin's direct planning question remains the one Shirou least wants.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She frankly asks his next move and he recognizes the pressure point.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's direct planning question remains the one Shirou least wants.

contexts.japanese: 「じゃあ率直に訊くけど。衛宮くん、貴方これからどうするつもり？」
contexts.english: "Then I'll be frank. What do you plan to do next?"

contexts.japanese: 本当に率直に、遠坂は一番訊いてほしくないコトを訊いてくる。
contexts.english: Tohsaka asks the one question I hoped she wouldn't.

counterexamples.description: Rin tests Shirou with a hypothetical city massacre rather than reporting one.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She asks whether his defensive posture means watching yesterday's enemy kill townspeople.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin tests Shirou with a hypothetical city massacre rather than reporting one.

contexts.japanese: 「ふーん、受けに回るんだ。それじゃあ他のマスターが何をしようが傍観するのね。例えば昨日のアイツが暴れ回って、町の人間を皆殺しにしても無視するってワケ」
contexts.english: "Hm. So you're going to play defense. You're just going to watch and see what the other Masters do? Even if that thing from yesterday goes around killing everyone in town, you'll just ignore it?"

counterexamples.description: Shirou's mass-killing question and Rin's qualified response remain hypothetical.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He asks about unscrupulous Masters; Rin says maybe, then argues an intelligent one would avoid waste.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's mass-killing question and Rin's qualified response remain hypothetical.

contexts.japanese: 「生贄にするって……それじゃ手段を選ばないヤツがマスターなら、サーヴァントを強くする為に人を殺しまくるってコトなのか」
contexts.english: "Sacrifice... Are you saying there might be Masters out there who go around killing people to make their Servants stronger, if they're not choosy about their methods?"

contexts.japanese: 「そうね。けど頭のいいヤツならそんな無駄な事はしないんじゃないかな」
contexts.english: "Maybe. But I can't see a smart Master doing something like that."

counterexamples.description: Rin exposes the contradiction in Shirou's reactive justice policy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She returns to whether he will merely watch; he says he will intervene, and she presses whether he hears his own inconsistency.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin exposes the contradiction in Shirou's reactive justice policy.

contexts.japanese: 「話を戻しましょうか。で、どうするの。
contexts.english: "We're getting off topic. So, what's next for you?

contexts.japanese: 「？　なんでしょうか、シロウ」
contexts.english: "What is it, Shirou?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page16:1
contexts.japanese: 「おはようセイバー。起こしてくれて助かった」
contexts.english: "Good morning, Saber. Thanks for waking me."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page16:1
contexts.japanese: 朝の挨拶をして、今度こそ廊下に出る。
contexts.english: I greet her, and then I head out to the hallway.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page16:1
contexts.japanese: ……しっかし、桜と揉めてるなんて何やらかしたんだ遠坂のヤツは—！
contexts.english: ...But seriously, what the hell did Tohsaka do to start an argument with Sakura!?

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page17:1
contexts.japanese: 「遠坂！」
contexts.english: "Tohsaka!"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page17:1
contexts.english: In the living room...

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page17:1
contexts.japanese: 居間には桜の姿はなく、遠坂一人がのんびりと天気予報を眺めていた。
contexts.english: There's no sign of Sakura. Tohsaka is alone, casually watching the weather forecast on TV.

counterexamples.description: Rin frames the disagreement as a temporary stay-away order and secures it through a one-week exchange for her own return home.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The ban is neither permanent nor unconditional.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin frames the disagreement as a temporary stay-away order and secures it through a one-week exchange for her own return home.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page19:1
contexts.japanese: おかしいな。とてもじゃないけど、桜と揉めていたような素振りじゃないぞ……？
contexts.english: That's weird. It doesn't look like she was fighting with Sakura at all.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page20:1
contexts.japanese: 「ああ、おはよう。……って、遠坂。なんでも桜と揉めたって聞いたんだが、ホントか？」
contexts.english: "Uh...morning. Hey, Tohsaka. I heard you and Sakura were arguing. Is that true?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page21:1
contexts.japanese: 「え？　……そっか、セイバーから聞いたのか。
contexts.english: "Huh? Oh, from Saber.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page21:1
contexts.japanese: ええ、客観的に見ればそういうコトになるけど、別に大したコトじゃないわよ？　単に、しばらくここには来るなって言いつけただけだから」
contexts.english: Yes, it may have seemed that way, to an outside observer, but it was nothing, really. I just told her not to come here for a while."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page22:1
contexts.japanese: さ、さらりと言いやがって、ようするに桜を出入り禁止にしたって事じゃないか！
contexts.english: Sh-she's so casual about basically banning Sakura from my house!

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page23:1
contexts.japanese: 「バカな。その話、桜は前にも断ってるじゃないか。それを繰り返したところで桜が承諾する筈が—」
contexts.english: "That's ridiculous. Sakura already said no to staying away from this house, so there's no way she would agree even if we asked again—"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page24:1
contexts.japanese: 「ないけど、交換条件を出したら帰ってくれたわよ？　　桜が一週間ここに来なければ、わたしは大人しく家に戻るって言ったの。それで交渉成立。渋々だけど帰っていったわ。ああそうそう、士郎によろしくだって」
contexts.english: "She wouldn't agree, but she went home after I presented her with a compromise. I told her I would go back home without argument if she stays away for a week. She agreed to those terms. She went home, even if she was a little reluctant. Oh right, she sends her regards."

counterexamples.description: Rin makes the arrangement; Shirou recognizes that she did something he should have done, and her guarded explanation follows.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin's stammer and self-safety claim remain visible rather than proving pure selfishness.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin makes the arrangement; Shirou recognizes that she did something he should have done, and her guarded explanation follows.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page24:1
contexts.japanese: 「ないけど、交換条件を出したら帰ってくれたわよ？　　桜が一週間ここに来なければ、わたしは大人しく家に戻るって言ったの。それで交渉成立。渋々だけど帰っていったわ。ああそうそう、士郎によろしくだって」
contexts.english: "She wouldn't agree, but she went home after I presented her with a compromise. I told her I would go back home without argument if she stays away for a week. She agreed to those terms. She went home, even if she was a little reluctant. Oh right, she sends her regards."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page25:1
contexts.japanese: ……いや、それは違うか。
contexts.english: Actually, I shouldn't yell at her for it.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page25:1
contexts.japanese: 遠坂は、俺がやらなくちゃいけない事をやってくれただけだ。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's just done something I should have.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page26:1
contexts.japanese: 「—そうだった。悪い、朝から面倒を押しつけちまった。気分悪くしただろう、遠坂」
contexts.english: "You're right. Sorry for making you be the bad guy so early in the morning. You must feel terrible, Tohsaka."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page26:1
contexts.japanese: 「？　いえ、別に面倒でも嫌でもなかったけど。なんだってそんなコト言うわけ、士郎？」
contexts.english: "Huh? No, it wasn't bad or unpleasant to me. Why would you think that, Shirou?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page27:1
contexts.japanese: 「いや。遠坂、桜と仲が良かっただろう。なのに面と向かって出ていけなんて、二回も言うのは嫌だった筈だ。
contexts.english: "Uh, because weren't you and Sakura friends? Telling Sakura to leave not once, but twice, doesn't sound like a fun job.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page27:1
contexts.japanese: だから悪かったって。しっかりしなくちゃいけないのに、また遠坂に負担をかけた」
contexts.english: That's why I feel bad. I'm the one who should take charge, but I made you do the dirty work again."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page28:1
contexts.japanese: 「—い、いいけど、そんなの。わたしだって自分の安全第一で桜を追い出したんだし。士郎にそう謝られる筋合いなんてないわ」
contexts.english: "Th-that's fine. I just kicked out Sakura for my own safety. There's no reason for you to apologize."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page28:1
contexts.japanese: 「……？　自分の安全第一って、なんでさ」
contexts.english: "Huh? What do you mean, for your own safety?"

counterexamples.description: The scene separates Shinji's possible hostage inference, his promise not to tell Sakura, danger at the house and nighttime travel risk.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou treats Shinji's promise as credible rather than omniscient fact.
counterexamples.explanation: The scene separates Shinji's possible hostage inference, his promise not to tell Sakura, danger at the house and nighttime travel risk.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page29:1
contexts.japanese: 「だって慎二がマスターだったんでしょう？
contexts.english: "Well, you said Shinji's a Master, right?

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page29:1
contexts.japanese: アイツの事だから、士郎んとこに桜がいるって判ったら目の仇にするに決まってるもの。だから慎二との決着がつくまでは、桜はここに居させないほうがいいのよ」
contexts.english: Knowing him, if Shinji finds out Sakura comes here, he'll target this place, so it's best to keep Sakura away from here until we've finished dealing with Shinji."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page30:1
contexts.japanese: ……そうか。
contexts.english: I get it.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page30:1
contexts.japanese: 言われてみればその通りだ。
contexts.english: She makes a good point.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page30:1
contexts.japanese: 慎二は、桜には何も話さないと言った。あの言葉に嘘はないと思う。
contexts.english: Shinji said he doesn't tell Sakura anything. I don't think he was lying.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page30:1
contexts.japanese: だが、妹である桜が俺たちのところに居るという事は、何かとよくない想像を抱かせてしまうだろう。
contexts.english: But if he finds out his little sister comes here so often, he might get the wrong idea.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page31:1
contexts.japanese: 「……だよな。慎二から見れば、桜を人質にとったように見えるもんな」
contexts.english: "You're right. It could look to Shinji like we're taking Sakura hostage."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page32:1
contexts.japanese: 「そういう事。もっともそんな事は別にして、ここが危険な事に変わりはないでしょ。
contexts.english: "Exactly. But more importantly, this place is still dangerous.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page32:1
contexts.japanese: あんまり頻繁に夜出歩かせるのも何だし、しばらくは遠慮してもらった方がいいのよ。それが桜のタメだし、わたしたちのタメでもある」
contexts.english: I wouldn't want her to be walking around at night, so it's best for her to stay away from here for a while. This is for Sakura's own safety, as well as ours."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page33:1
contexts.japanese: 「……ああ、そうだな。桜には悪いけど、後で謝って許してもらおう」
contexts.english: "...Yeah, you're right. I feel bad for Sakura, but I'll just have to apologize and ask her forgiveness later."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page33:1
contexts.japanese: もっとも、その時が来たとしても事情を話せないのは変わりがない。
contexts.english: Though I won't be able to explain myself even when the time comes.

counterexamples.description: Rin converts Shirou's sadness over Sakura into a reason to fight for restored ordinary peace despite not wanting the Grail.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her cruelty and effectiveness coexist in his evaluation.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin converts Shirou's sadness over Sakura into a reason to fight for restored ordinary peace despite not wanting the Grail.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page34:1
contexts.japanese: 「—はあ」
contexts.english: "...Hnnn."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page34:1
contexts.japanese: 本当にまいる。
contexts.english: This is really getting to me.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page34:1
contexts.japanese: 今までずっと手伝いにきてくれていた桜を、一時的にせよ、こういう形で断ってしまうというのは気が重い。
contexts.english: I feel really bad about turning Sakura away like this, even if it's temporary. She's been so unselfish about helping me for all this time.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page35:1
contexts.japanese: 「あら、随分と元気がないこと。さっき人を怒鳴りつけてくれた威勢は何処にいったのかしらね。衛宮くんはそんなに桜がいないと寂しいのかなぁ？」
contexts.english: "Oh, you look really down. What happened to all that energy you had when you shouted at me earlier? Are you all sad and lonely, not having Sakura around?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page36:1
contexts.japanese: ……しまった。コイツの前で弱みを見せるとつっつかれるって判ってきてたのに、ついやっちまった。
contexts.english: Oh crap. I've known she'd tease me whenever I show vulnerability, but I went and did it again.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page37:1
contexts.japanese: 「……ふん、ほっといてくれ。桜はうちの平和のシンボルだったんだよ。藤ねえと俺だけじゃ足りない所を補ってくれてたんだ。それをこっちの都合で追い返したんだから、気だって沈む」
contexts.english: "Hmph. Leave me alone. Sakura was the symbol of peace at our house. She offset whatever Fuji-nee and I were lacking. So of course I'm down about us sending her away for our own selfish reasons."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page38:1
contexts.japanese: 「なんだ、よく判ってるじゃない。それだけ言えれば合格よ。少しは勝ち気ってのが出てきたみたいね」
contexts.english: "Oh, so you do understand. If you can say that much, then you pass. I'd say you're starting to get more determined."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page38:1
contexts.japanese: 「？　な、何が言いたいんだよ、遠坂は」
contexts.english: "Huh? Wh-what are you trying to say?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page39:1
contexts.japanese: 「判らない？　つまりね、戦いが終われば桜は戻って来るでしょう？
contexts.english: "Don't you get it? Once this war ends, Sakura will come back.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page39:1
contexts.japanese: 士郎は聖杯なんて要らないっていうけど、それなら今まであってくれた平穏の為に戦えばいい。ほら、目的がハッキリしていいじゃない」
contexts.english: You say you don't want the Holy Grail, but that just means you should fight to take back the peaceful life you had before. See? Now you have a clear goal."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page39:1
contexts.japanese: 極上の笑顔で遠坂は言う。
contexts.english: Tohsaka smiles her very biggest smile.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page40:1
contexts.japanese: そんな風に言われたら納得するしかない。
contexts.english: When she puts it like that, I really have no choice but to agree.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page40:1
contexts.japanese: コイツは本当に、底なしに意地が悪くて、とんでもなく凄いヤツだと再確認してしまった。
contexts.english: What she said there confirms that she's both mean-spirited and ridiculously awesome at the same time.

counterexamples.description: Taiga theatrically polices the mixed household, Rin uses model-student speech, and Saber silently continues breakfast.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No impropriety is asserted to have occurred.
counterexamples.explanation: Taiga theatrically polices the mixed household, Rin uses model-student speech, and Saber silently continues breakfast.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page41:1
contexts.japanese: 「えー、じゃあしばらく桜ちゃんは来ないの？」
contexts.english: "What? So Sakura won't be coming here for a while?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page41:1
contexts.japanese: 「ああ。そういう事だから、藤ねえもたまには家で親孝行したらどうだ？　爺さん、娘にかまってもらえないって嘆いてたぞ」
contexts.english: "Yeah, that's what's going on. Why don't you do your parents a favor and go home once in a while for a change? Gramps was complaining about his daughter neglecting him."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page42:1
contexts.japanese: 「お父さんなんかほっといてもいいのっ。わたしがいなくたって死にゃしないんだから。
contexts.english: "Leave Dad out of this. He's not going to die or anything, whether I'm there or not.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page42:1
contexts.japanese: それにね、桜ちゃんがいないんなら余計わたしがしっかりしなくちゃダメじゃないっ。士郎だって男の子だもん、万が一があったら懲戒免職よ？　そうなったら責任とってくれる、士郎？」
contexts.english: And with Sakura gone, I have to be even more vigilant! You're still a boy, so if anything fishy happens here, I'll be the one who gets in trouble and even loses her job. If that happens, are you going to take responsibility, Shirou?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page43:1
contexts.japanese: 「んなコトな—」
contexts.english: "That'll never happen—"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page43:1
contexts.japanese: い、とは言い切れないのが男の性というか。
contexts.english: ...Sadly, since I'm a man, I can't really confidently deny that...

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page44:1
contexts.japanese: 「……衛宮くん？　何かしらね、今の止めは」
contexts.english: "Emiya? Why'd you just stop?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page44:1
contexts.japanese: じろりと。
contexts.english: She glares.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page44:1
contexts.japanese: 横から入ってくる遠坂の視線が痛い。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's eyes bore into me from one side.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page45:1
contexts.japanese: 「そう。良かった、やっぱり衛宮くんは信用できますね、先生」
contexts.english: "Good. I'm glad to hear that. Sounds like Emiya is trustworthy, Miss Fujimura."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page46:1
contexts.japanese: そんな二人を無言で眺め、黙々と箸を進めるセイバー。
contexts.english: Saber continues to eat in silence as she observes the two interacting.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page46:1
contexts.japanese: ……今日で二日目だが、この雰囲気に慣れる事なんて永遠に来ないと思う。
contexts.english: It's been two days, but I don't think I'll ever get used to this.

counterexamples.description: Rin reveals her close off-school friendship with Ayako, threatens exact repetition and conditions silence on a concession.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The tile-breaking remains sarcastic projected anger, not a past event.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin reveals her close off-school friendship with Ayako, threatens exact repetition and conditions silence on a concession.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page51:1
contexts.japanese: 「ねえねえ衛宮くん」
contexts.english: "Hey Emiya."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page51:1
contexts.japanese: と。
contexts.english: Suddenly...

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page52:1
contexts.japanese: 「わたしからもちょっと耳よりな話、してあげよっか」
contexts.english: "I have some news for you."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page52:1
contexts.japanese: 「？　なんだよ、今の話以上に耳よりな話は難しいぞ、本気で」
contexts.english: "Huh? What? I doubt it'll be more interesting than what I just heard."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page53:1
contexts.japanese: 「うん。今まで黙ってたけどね、わたしと綾子って仲良しなの。休みの日は二人で遊びに行くぐらいの仲って知ってた？」
contexts.english: "Yeah. I never mentioned this before, but Ayako and I are real good friends. Did you know we're close enough that we hang out on the weekends?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page53:1
contexts.japanese: —待て。
contexts.english: Wait.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page54:1
contexts.english: "Come again?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page54:1
contexts.japanese: 「今の話、一言一句間違えずに伝えてあげるから安心して。衛宮くんも喜んでたって言ったら、綾子ったらそりゃあもう瓦十枚はぶち抜くぐらいに喜ぶんじゃないかな」
contexts.english: "Oh, don't worry. I'm going to make sure I tell her every single word you just said. I'm sure if I tell her about how happy Emiya was when he heard about her predicament, why, I bet she'll break ten stacks of tiles from sheer delight!"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page55:1
contexts.japanese: 「—訂正したい。今のは言葉のあやだ。あまり人様に話すような発言じゃないんで、黙っていてくれると、とても助かる」
contexts.english: "...I...would like to amend my statement. See, it was just a figure of speech. It's not something I'd be proud if people heard, so I would really appreciate if you kept it to yourself."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page56:1
contexts.japanese: 「そうなの？　なら黙っていてもいいけど、それなりの条件がないときついかな。ほら、ついポロッと口に出る事ってあるじゃない？」
contexts.english: "Oh really? Well, I could keep quiet about it, but it would be reeeally hard for me to do that unless there was, maybe, something in it for me. I might just accidentally slip up, you know?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page57:1
contexts.japanese: ああ、誤解なんてしないって。
contexts.english: Yeah, there's no misunderstanding here.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page57:1
contexts.japanese: おまえ、間違いなく楽しんでるもん。
contexts.english: She's enjoying this.

counterexamples.description: The proposed payoff specifies Western breakfast, bread, marmalade, strawberry jam and Saber's soft egg preference, beginning the next day.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber corrects Shirou's claim that only Rin wants bread.
counterexamples.explanation: The proposed payoff specifies Western breakfast, bread, marmalade, strawberry jam and Saber's soft egg preference, beginning the next day.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page58:1
contexts.japanese: 「……分かった。これから朝食は洋風にする。
contexts.english: "Got it. I'll start making Western-style breakfasts from now on.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page59:1
contexts.japanese: 「—上出来ね。マーマレイドだけじゃなくて、イチゴのジャムも忘れないでくれると嬉しいわ」
contexts.english: "Good. And I think some jams, apart from marmalade, would be nice...like strawberry jam."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page59:1
contexts.japanese: 「………………はあ。ったく、日本の朝をなんだと思ってやがる、この外国かぶれ。おまえ一人の趣味で朝飯を変えやがって、この暴君」
contexts.english: "...I don't know what you have against Japanese breakfasts, you foreigner wannabe. I can't believe you would so radically change our breakfast just to suit your needs, you tyrant."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page60:1
contexts.japanese: 「—いいえ、それは違います。朝食がパンになるのは私も嬉しい。加えて半熟の玉子を用意していただければ、文句はないのですが」
contexts.english: "That is not entirely true. I would also be pleased to have bread served at breakfast. Soft-boiled eggs would also be an excellent addition."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page60:1
contexts.japanese: ……そしてしっかりと自分の意見を挟むセイバー。
contexts.english: Saber jumps right into the discussion.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page61:1
contexts.japanese: 「ああそうですか。分かったよ、洋食にすればいいんだろ、くそ。桜が洋食にしたからって調子づきやがって。
contexts.english: "Is that so? Fine. You all just want Western-style food, dammit. Sakura makes a Western-style breakfast one time and it goes right to your heads.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page61:1
contexts.japanese: お望みどおり明日から朝はパンにするから、それで文句はないな？　ならさっきの話は他言無用、絶対に美綴にはバラすなよ」
contexts.english: Fine then, I'll serve bread for tomorrow, so no more complaints, right? So what was said here, stays here. Don't you dare blab about this to Mitsuzuri."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page62:1
contexts.japanese: ふん、と二人から顔を逸らしてメシをかっこむ。
contexts.english: I huff, and shove rice into my mouth without looking at either of them.

counterexamples.description: Taiga reveals that silencing Rin is futile because she herself plans to tell Ayako and has not yet done so.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The final reversal remains prospective gossip.
counterexamples.explanation: Taiga reveals that silencing Rin is futile because she herself plans to tell Ayako and has not yet done so.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page62:1
contexts.japanese: 「なんでそんな無駄な事するのかなぁ？」
contexts.english: "Why would you be doing something so pointless?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page62:1
contexts.japanese: 俺と遠坂のやりとりを不思議そうに眺めていた藤ねえは、ぼんやりとそんな事を呟いた。
contexts.english: Fuji-nee, who had been watching our conversation with a look of wonderment, finally speaks up.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page63:1
contexts.japanese: 「……なんだよ。無駄ってなんだよ藤ねえ」
contexts.english: "What, what do you mean, pointless?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page63:1
contexts.japanese: 「だって遠坂さんが話さなくても、わたしが美綴さんに話しちゃうじゃん。こんな面白い話、黙ってられないよー、わたし」
contexts.english: "Even if Tohsaka isn't going to say anything, I'm going to tell Mitsuzuri anyway. No way would I pass up talking about something so interesting."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page63:1
セイバールート七日目-00:page63:1
contexts.japanese: ……いや。
contexts.english: Actually.

counterexamples.description: At seven-thirty Shirou rejects a joint walk to school because of his prior decision not to rely on Saber and announces his absence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The omitted commented line is not needed to preserve the active motivation.
counterexamples.explanation: At seven-thirty Shirou rejects a joint walk to school because of his prior decision not to rely on Saber and announces his absence.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page64:1
contexts.japanese: 朝食が終わって、時刻は七時半。
contexts.english: Breakfast ends, and it's seven-thirty.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page64:1
contexts.japanese: 藤ねえは珍しくうちに残っていて、三人で一緒に登校しよう、と笑顔で口にする。
contexts.english: Fuji-nee surprisingly stays back and suggests that the three of us walk to school.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page65:1
contexts.japanese: ……けど、それは出来ない。
contexts.english: ...But we can't do that.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page65:1
contexts.japanese: 昨夜の決着。
contexts.english: I made a decision last night.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page65:1
contexts.japanese: セイバーに頼らず、自分で戦うと口にした以上、もう悠長な真似はしていられない。
contexts.english: Now that I've said I won't rely on Saber, I can't afford to take it easy anymore.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page66:1
contexts.japanese: 「それじゃ行こっか。戸締まりはいい、士郎？」
contexts.english: "Then let's go. Did you lock up, Shirou?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page66:1
contexts.japanese: 「いや、戸締まりはいいよ。俺、今日学校休むから」
contexts.english: "No, don't worry about locking up. I'm not going to school today."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page66:1
contexts.japanese: じゃあな、と手をあげて藤ねえと遠坂を見送る。
contexts.english: I wave Fuji-nee and Tohsaka off.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page67:1
contexts.japanese: 藤ねえはぽかん、と数秒固まったあと、
contexts.english: Fuji-nee freezes, stupefied for just a few seconds.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page67:1
contexts.japanese: 「ちょっと、学校休むってどういうコトよ！」
contexts.english: "What!? What do you mean you're not going to school!?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page67:1
contexts.english: "Eh, huh?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page67:1
contexts.japanese: 遠坂に、言いたいコトを言われてしまったみたいだ。
contexts.english: Tohsaka beat Fuji-nee to the chase.

counterexamples.description: Taiga detects the old-scar excuse, Shirou admits the lie and asks to remain home for more important work; she yields based on his longstanding pattern.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He suspends outside work and plans to guard the house.
counterexamples.explanation: Taiga detects the old-scar excuse, Shirou admits the lie and asks to remain home for more important work; she yields based on his longstanding pattern.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page68:1
contexts.japanese: 「そ、そうよ士郎。学校休むって、士郎どこも悪くないでしょ？」
contexts.english: "Th-that's right. You don't look sick enough to miss school today, Shirou."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page68:1
contexts.japanese: 「いや、傷が痛んでるんだ。気温が下がると古傷って痛むだろ。そんな感じ」
contexts.english: "No, but my scar hurts. You know how scars hurt when the weather changes? It's like that."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page69:1
contexts.japanese: 「むっ……それ、嘘でしょ士郎」
contexts.english: "Hm... You're lying, Shirou."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page69:1
contexts.japanese: 「嘘だけど、それで勘弁してくれ藤ねえ。何も学校がイヤって訳じゃないんだ。やる事があって、そっちのが今は重要なだけなんだ。だからさ、それで許してくれないか」
contexts.english: "Yeah, but let me off the hook just for today, Fuji-nee. It's not that I don't like school. There's something I have to do, and it's just more important right now. So let me go."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page70:1
contexts.japanese: 「………………もう。そんな言い方されたらわたしの負けじゃない。士郎が事情を話さない時っていっつもそうなんだもん。むかしっからそうだよね」
contexts.english: "...Oh come on, how can I respond if you are going to put it like that? You always were cagey when you had something really important to take care of."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page70:1
contexts.japanese: 藤ねえは文句を言いつつ、とりあえず納得してくれたようだ。
contexts.english: Fuji-nee is complaining, but at least she understands.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page71:1
contexts.japanese: 「そういう訳だ。学校の方は遠坂に任せる。」
contexts.english: "So there it is. I'll leave the school to you, Tohsaka."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page71:1
contexts.japanese: 「……そ。まあ、衛宮くんが居ようが居なかろうがこっちには支障はないし。確かに悪くない選択よ、それ」
contexts.english: "O-okay. Not much is going to change just because you're not there. That's not a bad idea, Emiya."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page72:1
contexts.japanese: 「ああ、留守は任せてくれ。しばらくはバイトも休むから、家はそう空けないよ」
contexts.english: "Yeah, leave the house to me. I'm not going to work for a while either, so I won't be leaving the house much."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page72:1
contexts.japanese: 「……わかった。それじゃ行ってくるね、士郎。ケガで学校を休むんだから、あんまり外に出ちゃだめよ」
contexts.english: "Got it. Then I'm heading out, Shirou. If you're going to skip school because you're hurt, you shouldn't leave the house much."

counterexamples.description: After dinner Shirou cools his head until Saber reminds him of Rin's night lesson, and he goes to the upstairs guest room.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The scene follows daytime training and the changing-room incident rather than immediately following breakfast.
counterexamples.explanation: After dinner Shirou cools his head until Saber reminds him of Rin's night lesson, and he goes to the upstairs guest room.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page0:1
contexts.japanese: —夕食が終わった。
contexts.english: We finish dinner.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page1:1
contexts.english: "...So cold."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page1:1
contexts.japanese: 縁側の窓を開け、外の風で頭を冷やしていたがそれもここまでだ。
contexts.english: I had opened a window from the veranda to let the outside wind cool my head, but I need to stop.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page1:1
contexts.japanese: いつまでもこんなコトしていたら風邪を引いちまう。
contexts.english: I'm going to catch a cold if I keep this up.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page2:1
contexts.japanese: 「シロウ、ここにいたのですか」
contexts.english: "Shirou, there you are."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page2:1
contexts.japanese: 「セ、セイバー……！？　な、なんだよ、俺になんか用か」
contexts.english: "S-Saber!? D-did you have something?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page3:1
contexts.english: "Oh."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page3:1
contexts.japanese: ぱし、と頭を叩く。
contexts.english: I smack my forehead.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page3:1
contexts.japanese: 「すっかり忘れてた。さんきゅ、今すぐ行ってくる！」
contexts.english: "I completely forgot. Thanks. I'll head over there right away!"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page4:1
contexts.japanese: 別棟に駆け込んで、二階にあがる。
contexts.english: I rush to the outbuilding and head upstairs.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page4:1
contexts.japanese: 遠坂が占拠した客間のドアをノックすると、
contexts.english: I knock on the door to the guestroom that Tohsaka has taken up occupancy in.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page4:1
contexts.japanese: 「士郎？　いいわよ、ちょっと今手が放せないから、勝手に入って」
contexts.english: "Shirou? I have my hands full, so just come on in, it's fine."

counterexamples.description: Rin draws her own blood with an empty syringe, feeds a jewel drop by drop, and judges the current stone thirty percent complete against nine on hand.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No drug injection or total personal mana percentage is invented.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin draws her own blood with an empty syringe, feeds a jewel drop by drop, and judges the current stone thirty percent complete against nine on hand.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page5:1
contexts.japanese: 遠坂は宝石らしきものを手のひらに置いて、もう一方の手には注射器、口にはハンカチらしきものを咥えている。
contexts.english: I walk in to see Tohsaka holding a jewel in one hand, a syringe in the other, and a handkerchief in her mouth.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page6:1
contexts.japanese: 「質問していいかな、遠坂」
contexts.english: "I...have questions, Tohsaka."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page7:1
contexts.japanese: 言って、遠坂は注射器を自分の腕に刺す。
contexts.english: She sticks a needle in her arm as she speaks, her mouth full.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page7:1
contexts.japanese: ……カラの注射器に血が吸い上げられていく。
contexts.english: ...She draws blood into the syringe.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page7:1
contexts.japanese: そうして摘出した血を今度は一滴一滴宝石に零したかと思うと、血に濡れたそれを握りしめた。
contexts.english: Tohsaka slowly drips blood from the syringe onto the jewel, then grips it tightly.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page9:1
contexts.japanese: 「……はあ。これだけやってもまだ三割か。やっぱり手持ちの九つだけでやっていかなくちゃダメみたいね」
contexts.english: "...Even after all that, it's only at thirty percent. I guess I'll have to make do with just the nine I have."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page9:1
contexts.japanese: 遠坂はがっくりと肩を落とし、宝石箱らしきものに石を戻す。
contexts.english: Tohsaka slumps her shoulders in disappointment, and puts the stone back into a jewelry box.

counterexamples.description: Rin explains magic bullets, jewel affinity, stored surplus over days to years, capacity limits and ignition of great magecraft.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Detached energy is not freely controlled.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin explains magic bullets, jewel affinity, stored surplus over days to years, capacity limits and ignition of great magecraft.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page10:1
contexts.japanese: 「遠坂。約束通り、教えを乞いに来たんだけど」
contexts.english: "Tohsaka. I came here to learn from you, as promised."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page10:1
contexts.japanese: その前に、今の行為がとても気になるのだがどうしたものか。
contexts.english: But before we get to that, I'm curious about what I just saw.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page13:1
contexts.japanese: 「さて、それじゃあ何から行こうか。たしか士郎は強化の魔術しか使えないって言ってたけど—」
contexts.english: "So...what should we start with? You mentioned that you can only use Strengthening magecraft..."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page13:1
contexts.japanese: 「いや、その前にちょっといいか。やっぱり気になる。
contexts.english: "Uh, actually before we start, I need to know, or else it's going to bother me.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page13:1
contexts.japanese: 遠坂さ、さっき何してたんだよ。注射器を自分に刺すなんて危ないだろ」
contexts.english: What the hell were you just doing? Sticking yourself with a needle is dangerous."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page14:1
contexts.japanese: 「え、あれ？　あれは魔弾を作ってただけよ。遠坂の魔術は力の流動と転換だからね。こうやって余裕がある時は、自分の魔力を余所に移しておくのよ」
contexts.english: "Eh, huh? I was just making magic bullets. My family's style of magecraft uses the flow and conversion of power. Whenever I have the time, I transfer my magical energy to other objects."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page15:1
contexts.japanese: 「待ってくれ。その魔弾とか、魔力を移しておくってなんだよ」
contexts.english: "Wait. What are magic bullets, and what's the point of transferring magical energy?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page16:1
contexts.japanese: 「魔弾は魔弾よ。魔力の籠った弾。
contexts.english: "Magic bullets are exactly what they sound like: bullets filled with magical energy.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page16:1
contexts.japanese: 宝石は人の念が宿りやすいって聞いたコトない？　実際、宝石は魔力を溜めやすい物なんだけど、うちの家系はさらに相性がいいみたいなのよね」
contexts.english: Have you ever heard stories where jewels contain human emotions and thoughts? Jewels in general can easily store magical energy, and it seems like my family has always been really well-suited to the practice."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page17:1
contexts.japanese: 「魔力を込めるっていうのは、たとえば今日一日なにもしなかったら体力は余ってるでしょ？　その余った分の力を宝石にため込んでおくの。
contexts.english: "If you don't do anything for, say, a day, you wind up with an excess of magical energy. So, I put that extra energy into jewels.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page17:1
contexts.japanese: これを何日、何ヶ月、何年と続けて、宝石自体を“魔術”にするのよ」
contexts.english: I repeat this for days, months, and even years, and that turns the jewels themselves into magecraft."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page18:1
contexts.japanese: 「もっとも宝石自体にだってキャパはあるし、自分から離れた魔力なんてものは操れない。
contexts.english: "The jewels obviously have limited capacity, and I can't control magical energy outside myself.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page18:1
contexts.japanese: 宝石に込めた魔力っていうのは、あくまで大魔術を瞬間的に発動させる為だけのイグニッションにすぎないけどね」
contexts.english: The magical energy inside the jewels works like an ignition source to instantly activate a large-scale magecraft."

counterexamples.description: Shirou uses computer metaphors that Rin does not understand; she answers with rear-support and disposable-pack language before explaining attribute restrictions.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin is not made computer-literate.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou uses computer metaphors that Rin does not understand; she answers with rear-support and disposable-pack language before explaining attribute restrictions.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page19:1
contexts.japanese: 「……む？　えーと、ようするに自分の魔力を宝石に込めて、バックアップをとるってコトか？」
contexts.english: "Hm? So you're saying you fill these jewels with your own magical energy as a backup?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page19:1
contexts.japanese: 「後方支援……？　んー、近いけど違うっていうか、使い捨てのリュックサックの中身をつめてるだけよ」
contexts.english: "Backup...like combat support? Mmm...that's close, but not quite right. It's more like stuffing something into a disposable pack."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page20:1
contexts.japanese: 「じゃあ一時的にハードディスクを増設してるってコトか。……すごいな、それなら魔術なんて使いたい放題じゃないか」
contexts.english: "So, it's like you're temporarily expanding a computer hard disk. That's amazing. You'd be able to use as much magecraft as you want with that kind of skill."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page21:1
contexts.japanese: 「はーどでぃすく……？　アンタの言ってるコトはよく判らないけど、そこまで便利なものじゃないわよ。魔力は宝石に込めた時点で、その宝石の属性に染まるから用途は限られてしまうわけだし」
contexts.english: "Hard...disk? No idea what that is, but it's also not as great as you think. The moment I infuse the jewel with magical energy, the magical energy is bound by the jewel's attributes, which limits how I can use it."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page22:1
contexts.japanese: 「……ふーん。それにしても驚いたな。魔力っていうのは、そういうふうに貯めておくコトもできるものなんだ。
contexts.english: "Yeah? But magical energy never ceases to surprise me. I didn't know you could store it like that.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page22:1
contexts.japanese: そんな便利なコト、なんで他の魔術師はしないんだろう」
contexts.english: Why don't other mages do something so useful?"

counterexamples.description: Persistent jewel storage leads to Magic Crests; Shirou reveals for the first time that he lacks one, and Rin realizes he began from zero.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin is not shown as having known all along.
counterexamples.explanation: Persistent jewel storage leads to Magic Crests; Shirou reveals for the first time that he lacks one, and Rin realizes he began from zero.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page23:1
contexts.japanese: 「自分以外の物に魔力を貯めるっていうのは特殊なのよ。
contexts.english: "The ability to store magical energy in something outside yourself is unique.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page24:1
contexts.japanese: 「で、うちの家系はそうならないように、うまく宝石に魔力を流動させて永続的な物にしているんだけど……他の魔術師だって、自分の体になら同じような事はできるわ。
contexts.english: "What my family does is make it so the magical energy flows into jewels, where they become permanent objects...but other mages can do something similar to their own bodies.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page25:1
contexts.japanese: 「魔術刻印……ああ、親が子供に譲るっていう秘伝の話だな。俺、それはないからどうもピンとこないな」
contexts.english: "Magic Crests...oh yeah, secrets that parents pass down to their children. I don't have anything like that so I'm kind of clueless about them."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page26:1
contexts.japanese: 「ちょっと。アンタ、今なんて言ったの？」
contexts.english: "Wait. What did you just say?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page26:1
contexts.japanese: 「えっ……いや、魔術刻印はないって言ったんだが。親父は持ってたみたいだけど、譲られはしなかった」
contexts.english: "Huh? Well, I just said I don't have a Magic Crest. My old man had one, but I didn't inherit it."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page28:1
contexts.japanese: 「どうりで素人同然の訳だ。……じゃあホントに一からやってるのね……うん、なら確かにしょうがないか」
contexts.english: "No wonder you're such an amateur. So you really started from zero. Then I guess there's no helping it."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page29:1
contexts.japanese: 「……遠坂。俺に魔術刻印がないって、随分前に気が付いてたんじゃないのか？」

contexts.japanese: 「そんな訳ないでしょ。知ってたら一人でなんか行動させなかったわよ。……そりゃあ半人前だなって思ってたけど、魔術刻印がないならそもそも魔術師じゃないじゃない、士郎は」
contexts.english: "Of course not. If I knew, I would have never let you go out and do stuff on your own. Sure, I knew you weren't fully trained, but if you don't have a Magic Crest, you aren't even a mage."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page31:1
contexts.japanese: ただ、なんだろう。
contexts.english: But...what is this?

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page31:1
contexts.japanese: 今の言葉は、どこかホッとしたような、俺が魔術師じゃなくて羨ましがっているような、そんな温かみがあった。
contexts.english: Her voice sounds almost warm... Like she is a little bit relieved... Like she's jealous I'm not a mage.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page32:1
contexts.japanese: はい、士郎はそこに座って。大事な話だからちゃんと腰を落ち着かせて聞くこと」

contexts.english: "Right here? Okay, go ahead."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page33:1
contexts.japanese: ぐっ、と気合いをいれて遠坂の目を見る。
contexts.english: I brace myself and look straight at Tohsaka.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page33:1
contexts.japanese: こっちの真剣ぶりが伝わったのか、遠坂は満足げに頷いた。

contexts.japanese: 「じゃあ簡単な話から入るけど。
contexts.english: "I'll start with something simple.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page34:1
contexts.japanese: 魔術を使うのに必要なものが魔力だって事は知ってるわよね？　魔術さえ発動させられるなら、それらは全て魔力と言い換えても差し支えはないわ。
contexts.english: You already know that you need magical energy to use magecraft. You can actually refer to anything that can activate magecraft as magical energy.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page34:1
contexts.japanese: 魔力の種類は千差万別。
contexts.english: There are endless varieties of magical energy.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page34:1
contexts.japanese: ここまでは知ってるでしょ？」
contexts.english: You at least know that, right?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page35:1
contexts.japanese: 「ああ。大源と小源の事だろ。大源が自然、世界に満ちてる魔力。小源が個人が生成できる魔力だ」
contexts.english: "Yeah. You're talking about mana and od. Mana is magical energy that's found throughout the world, while od is magical energy an individual can create themselves."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page35:1
contexts.japanese: 「そうそう、よくできました。じゃあその大源を用いた魔術から順に説明しましょう」
contexts.english: "Yep, yep. Good job. Let me start by explaining the types of magecraft that use mana."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page36:1
contexts.japanese: これは古くからシステムとして確立している儀式、供物をもって神秘と接触する方法よ」
contexts.english: It's a method based on a long established system of rituals using offerings to make contact with Mystics."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page37:1
contexts.japanese: これなら術者の魔力が希薄でも魔術は作用する。なにしろ使用する魔力は自分からではなく他所から借り受けるものだから、術者はただ儀式を行うだけでいい」
contexts.english: This way, even a caster with weak magical energy can use magecraft. They don't need to use their own magical energy because they're borrowing it from elsewhere—from mana—so the caster only has to perform a ritual."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page38:1
contexts.japanese: 「……けどまあ、こういうのは知識がないと出来ないからね。士郎にはまだ無理だし、そもそもこういう血生臭いのは向いてないわ、貴方には」
contexts.english: "But you need knowledge to pull something like this off. You're not at the right level to do something like this. Besides, something reeking of blood probably wouldn't be your style anyway."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page39:1
contexts.japanese: 「……だな。俺も鶏の生け贄とか、魔法陣を敷いて一晩中祈るとか、そういうのはやりたくない」
contexts.english: "Yeah. I wouldn't want to do stuff like sacrifice chickens or pray for a whole night inside a magic circle."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page40:1
contexts.japanese: 「でしょ。
contexts.english: "Right?

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page40:1
contexts.japanese: じゃあこれは置いといて、次は小源、つまり魔術師個人の力で行う魔術の事。
contexts.english: Then let's move on and talk about od...magecraft that uses the mage's own power.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page40:1
contexts.japanese: もう言うまでもないと思うけど、これがわたしや貴方の基本的な魔術行使よ。
contexts.english: This probably doesn't bear mentioning, but it is the basic method for using the magecraft you and I practice.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page40:1
contexts.japanese: 士郎の“強化”は他者の力を借りないでする、自身の魔術回路だけを頼りにした魔術でしょう？」
contexts.english: Your Strengthening magecraft only uses your own Magic Circuits without using anybody else's power, right?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page41:1
contexts.japanese: こくん、と頷く。
contexts.english: I nod.

counterexamples.description: Hereditary circuits and accumulated secret magecraft remain distinct; a crest is useful for ordinary practice yet inadequate for the lineage's farther destination.

counterexamples.explanation: Hereditary circuits and accumulated secret magecraft remain distinct; a crest is useful for ordinary practice yet inadequate for the lineage's farther destination.

contexts.japanese: 「その、自分だけの魔力を生成する機能—“魔術回路”っていうのは、先祖代々受け継がれる遺伝体質なの。
contexts.english: "Right. The Magic Circuits that function to create your own magical energy are a hereditary trait passed down through generations.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page42:1

contexts.english: Magic Circuits are forged over many generations, and get more powerful as they're passed down to the next generation and so on.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page42:1
contexts.japanese: 魔術師の家系の子供は、それだけで魔術に適した人間ってわけ。フェアじゃないけど、わたしと士郎はスタート地点からして違うって事よ」
contexts.english: The child of a mage family is already fit to use magical energy because of this. It may not be fair, but you and I had different starting points."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page43:1
contexts.japanese: 「それは知ってる。気にしてないから、話を続けていいぞ遠坂」
contexts.english: "I know that. It doesn't bother me. Keep going."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page43:1
contexts.japanese: 「……別に気にしてなんかないけど。
contexts.english: "I wasn't too worried about that either...

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page43:1
contexts.japanese: ま、いいわ。それでね、そういった魔術回路とは別に、その家系が代々鍛え上げてきた秘伝の魔術っていうのがあるのよ」
contexts.english: But whatever. Anyway, other than Magic Circuits, mage families also have secret magecrafts that they cultivate over generations."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page45:1
contexts.japanese: 「—判らないが、体の一部になったようなものなんだろうな、手に取れるっていう事は」
contexts.english: "I don't, but I'm guessing it's like it becomes a part of your body."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page46:1
contexts.japanese: 「ご名答。
contexts.english: "Bingo.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page47:1
contexts.japanese: ……ま、残した方も残された方も、そんな刻印が何の役にも立たないって判ってるんだけどさ」
contexts.english: Though to be honest, both the one handing down the crest and the one receiving it know it's of no help."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page48:1
contexts.japanese: 「……？　なんだよ、それだけ凄い刻印なのに何の役にも立たないのか？」
contexts.english: "Huh? What? Are you saying that something so awesome is useless?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page49:1
contexts.japanese: ……まあけど、それは自動車をもらったようなものなのよ。どんなに地上を速く走れても、月には辿り着けないんだから」
contexts.english: But then again, it's like getting a car. No matter how fast it is on the road, it's never going to take you to the moon."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page49:1
contexts.english: Huh?

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page50:1
contexts.japanese: もう判ったと思うけど、その刻印っていうのが魔術刻印なの」
contexts.english: You might know this already, but this crest is what's called a Magic Crest."

counterexamples.description: Rin corrects Shirou that books hold family records while crests hold spells; the crest behaves like one living organ and appears on her left arm only during use.
counterexamples.sourceReading: It is not confused with permanently visible Command Spells.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin corrects Shirou that books hold family records while crests hold spells; the crest behaves like one living organ and appears on her left arm only during use.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page51:1
contexts.japanese: 「その家柄の当主が一生をかけて完成させた魔術を刻印にして子孫に譲り、子孫はさらに次の魔術を完成させて刻印を増やし、また子孫に継承する。
contexts.english: "The head of the mage family spends their entire life completing their magecraft and makes it into a crest to pass it down to their descendants, and the descendant completes another magecraft and adds it to the crest, which gets passed down to the next descendant.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page52:1
contexts.japanese: 「…………。つまり魔術刻印には、その家系の全てが記録されているって事か？」
contexts.english: "So what you're saying is that the entire history of a mage family is recorded in these Magic Crests?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page53:1
contexts.japanese: 「あ、それは違う。家系の記録はちゃんと書物で残してるわよ。魔術刻印にあるのは、単純に魔術だけなの。
contexts.english: "No, that's not it. Family records are recorded in books. Magic Crests only contain magecraft.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page53:1
contexts.japanese: 勝手に呪文詠唱をしてくれたり、自分が修得していない魔術も使えたりするだけ。
contexts.english: It can cast spells on its own, or it can let you use magecraft you haven't mastered yet.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page53:1
contexts.japanese: 判りやすく言えば自分の体に魔法陣を刻んでいるようなものかな」
contexts.english: In simpler terms, it's like having magic circles engraved on your body."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page54:1
contexts.japanese: 「…………ふむ。それじゃあさ、別に刻印は誰に刻んでもいいって事にならないか？　魔法陣なら、カタチさえ知っていれば幾つでも描けるじゃないか」
contexts.english: "Huh. Then doesn't that mean you can engrave the crests onto anyone. If magic circles are all you need, then you can draw as many as you want as long as you know the shape."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page55:1
contexts.japanese: 「それがそういう訳にもいかないのよ。
contexts.english: "That's not how it works.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page55:1
contexts.japanese: 魔術刻印っていうのはね、生き物みたいなものなの。臓器を移植する事に近いわ。
contexts.english: Magic Crests are like living things. It's more like transplanting an organ.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page55:1
contexts.japanese: 臓器は一つしかないモノだから、何人かに分け与えるとか写本するとか、そういったコトは出来ないの。　心臓を二つに分けても意味ないでしょ？　結局、分けても機能しなくなるだけなんだから」
contexts.english: There's only one organ, so you can't split it amongst other people or copy it. There's no point in splitting a heart in half, because it'd just stop working, right?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page56:1
contexts.japanese: 「あ……む。そうか、たしかに。それじゃ遠坂にも、その刻印は移植されてるのか？」
contexts.english: "Oh...yeah, you have a point. Does that mean you also have a crest implanted in you too?"

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page57:1
contexts.japanese: 「……移植ってのは、我ながら後ろ向きな例えだったわね。
contexts.english: "'Implanted' is a pretty backwards way to put it, if I do say so myself.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page57:1
contexts.japanese: わたしの場合は左腕。肩から手までびっしりね。ただ魔術刻印は使わなければ浮かび上がらないから、令呪と違って隠す必要はないわ」
contexts.english: In my case it's on my left arm. It covers my entire arm from my shoulders to my hand. It doesn't show up as long as I'm not using it, so I don't have to hide it like with Command Spells."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page61:1
contexts.japanese: ……うん、今夜はここでお開きにしましょ。明日までには色々と用意しておくから、それまで待ってちょうだい」

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page64:1
contexts.japanese: うわ。なんか、いま本気でぶるっときたんだがっ。
contexts.english: A chill runs down my spine.

contexts.english: "What? I'll stop if you don't want to do it. But if so, there won't be much I can teach you."

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page65:1
